title: Freelance Credit Research Analyst – Latin America
description:
Freelance Credit Research Analyst – Latin America

We're looking for an experienced credit research analyst to join our Debtwire Credit Research Team. The team provides unique insights and valuation analysis on companies and their securities that are restructuring, in the process of a transforming event or raising capital. Key tasks will include reviewing financial statements and legal documents to produce detailed credit research on stressed, distressed, and restructuring companies. The analysis will be produced in reports produced for subscribers of Debtwire, an ION Analytics subsidiary.

You will have the option to work remotely, including a flexible contract and competitive rates.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Produce Credit Reports that provide financial and valuation analysis on high-yield, distressed and stressed companies.
  • Interact with subscribers electronically and personally to discuss credit and macro analysis.
  • Along with creating credit research, the candidate will assist in special reports and ad-hoc projects.
  • Interact with management and IR teams of companies covered. Attend conferences and company investor day as needed.

Required Skills, Experience, and Qualifications

  • The candidate should have 5+ years as either a credit or equity analyst.
  • Naturally curious and driven to figure out how to analyze complex situations and be tenacious in obtaining information.
  • Excellent understanding of financial statements: income statement, balance sheet and cash flows and the drive to thoroughly read the information supporting the financial statements.
  • A thorough understanding of debt and equity securities and the markets they trade in is required, including some knowledge of bankruptcy processes.
  • Valuation experience including waterfall, and DCF analysis is required.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of fixed income analytics (ie Z-spread, duration).
  • Fluency in Portuguese and/or Spanish (both strongly preferred).
  • Comprehensive knowledge of Excel and Word
  • Excellent writing skills, with the ability to build a thesis and reach a conclusion in a structured manner, are required.
  • Experience writing reports in English.
  • Ability to work in a team-based environment, with a sense of teamwork and cooperation
  • Ability to manage workflow under strict deadlines
About us

We’re a diverse group of visionary innovators who provide trading and workflow automation software, high-value analytics, and strategic consulting to corporations, central banks, financial institutions, and governments. Founded in 1999, we’ve achieved tremendous growth by bringing together some of the best and most successful financial technology companies in the world.

• Over 2,000 of the world’s leading corporations, including 50% of the Fortune 500 and 30% of the world’s central banks, trust ION solutions to manage their cash, in-house banking, commodity supply chain, trading and risk.

A technology-driven risk and compliance platform that empowers businesses to manage third-party insurance requirements with confidence. By combining deep insurance expertise with modern AI tools, they deliver real-time insights, reduce risk exposure, and streamline operations. Through their newest platform, they are redefining certificate of insurance tracking with automation and intelligent workflows that simplify complex compliance processes and support business growth.


Job Summary

We’re looking for an AI Engineer to help build scalable AI-powered systems using Large Language Models (LLMs) for document understanding, retrieval-augmented generation, and intelligent classification tasks. This is a hands-on role ideal for someone who thrives on shipping real-world AI applications, collaborating cross-functionally with engineering and product teams, and applying state-of-the-art NLP techniques to practical use cases. You’ll play a key part in designing and optimizing LLM pipelines that drive smarter workflows, improve automation, and enhance the customer experience.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement systems that integrate LLMs into production environments (e.g., summarization, classification, RAG pipelines).

  • Fine-tune or adapt foundation models to suit domain-specific use cases.

  • Build and maintain prompt-based and retrieval-augmented workflows to improve accuracy and context.

  • Evaluate and benchmark LLM performance on custom tasks and datasets.

  • Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams to build end-user features powered by AI.

  • Monitor and optimize inference performance, latency, and cost.

  • Stay current with the latest in NLP research, tooling, and model architectures.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • 3+ years in AI/ML engineering, with at least 1 year of hands-on work with LLMs.

  • Proficiency in Python and experience integrating models via APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Hugging Face, LangChain).

  • Understanding of embeddings, vector search, and semantic retrieval techniques.

  • Familiarity with prompt engineering, model evaluation, and fine-tuning practices.

  • Demonstrated experience contributing to deployed AI-powered products or internal tools.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

Na Bemisa, todas as candidaturas são bem-vindas, independentemente de etnia, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, idade, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

Valorizamos um ambiente em que todos se sintam engajados e capazes de contribuir com suas habilidades para impulsionar nosso crescimento.

Para continuar construindo uma cultura inclusiva e diversa, contamos com candidaturas de bons profissionais como você para futuras oportunidades na nossa empresa.

Modelo de trabalho

Área Corporativa: formato híbrido, com atuação presencial de quatro dias por semana e um dia home office;

Área Operacional: formato presencial, com atuação em horário administrativo ou escala de turno.

Você está se candidatando ao nosso Banco de Talentos , criado exclusivamente para pessoas com deficiência , que desejam desenvolver seu potencial, explorar diversas áreas de atuação e aprender mais sobre o setor de mineração.

Assim que surgir uma oportunidade alinhada ao seu perfil, entraremos em contato. Enquanto isso, mantenha seu currículo atualizado para que possamos conhecê-lo melhor.

As vagas serão para as regiões:

  • Belo Horizonte/MG
  • Água Azul do Norte/PA
  • Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Nossos benefícios atuais incluem:

  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Assistência Funeral;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Wellhub - Plataforma de atividades físicas e bem-estar;
  • Apoiopass - Programa de apoio e cuidado para colaboradores e familiares;
  • Programa Empresa Cidadã - Licença maternidade de 6 meses e paternidade de 20 dias.

*Os benefícios podem variar de acordo com a região da vaga.

Com 17 anos de experiência, estamos presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil, com um portfólio diversificado de minerais, incluindo minério de ferro, ouro, níquel, terras raras, fosfato e calcário.

Temos projetos em diferentes fases, desde exploração até operação, com cerca de 1000 colaboradores engajados em nosso propósito.

A Mina Baratinha, localizada no Vale do Aço, Minas Gerais, tem capacidade de produção de aproximadamente 2,5 milhões de toneladas anuais de minério de ferro de alto teor e baixos níveis de contaminantes. Em julho de 2023, iniciamos a implantação do Projeto Mongais, com capacidade de 1,0 milhão de toneladas por ano, dentro do Complexo de Baratinha. Em Água Azul, nossa primeira operação de ouro, localizada no sul do Pará, iniciou sua fase de comissionamento em 2023.

Acreditamos no potencial da mineração brasileira e estamos comprometidos com a sustentabilidade, promovendo desenvolvimento socioeconômico em todas as regiões onde atuamos.

title: Technical Purchaser
description:
This position is responsible for the procurement of medium to large equipment packages, ensuring adherence to Supply Chain procedures and alignment with project-specific requirements. The role involves managing the full procurement cycle — from requisition to delivery — while working closely with internal departments, suppliers, and logistics to guarantee timely, cost-effective, and compliant operations. It also includes contract negotiation, supplier performance management, and continuous contribution to process improvement and strategic sourcing initiatives.

  • Responsible for the procurement of medium to large equipment packages, in accordance with SC procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with BW Energy’s SC procedures and project-specific Procurement Plans.
  • Manage procurement, expediting, and supply chain control from requisition to onboard delivery.
  • Liaise with freight forwarders and logistics to optimize deliveries and minimize freight/customs costs.
  • Ensure quality and suitability of equipment/spares in coordination with relevant departments.
  • Apply thorough cost control throughout procurement activities.
  • Issue Purchase Orders in IFS and perform material receiving when required.
  • Monitor changes in the supplier market; maintain balanced contact with local and global suppliers.
  • Participate in supplier meetings and contribute to supplier relationship development.
  • Maintain commodity knowledge and oversee the development of the Bidders List.
  • Support implementation and understanding of frame agreements and identify needs for new agreements.
  • Prepare and issue RFQs.
  • Evaluate bids, perform clarifications, and negotiate with suppliers.
  • Analyze TCO / Life Cycle Costs and recommend awards.
  • Coordinate with Legal on contract terms and supplier qualifications.
  • Participate in the negotiation and implementation of strategic contracts (short, long-term or MSAs).
  • Monitor supplier production schedules and ensure delivery capability.
  • Identify and mitigate risks to delivery schedules.
  • Maintain IFS database accuracy; liaise quarterly with requisitioners to validate open requests.
  • Prepare regular Procurement Status Reports (PSR).
  • Ensure compliance with E&P policies, internal controls, and applicable tax regulations.
  • Guarantee the implementation of contracts for oil lifting operations.
  • Contribute to global SC initiatives and bid inputs for new contracts.
  • Support alignment of local SC practices with global best practices.
  • Promote continuous improvement through lessons learned and best practice adoption.
  • Ensure compliance with local content requirements.


Education

  • Education / degree within Purchasing and/or Logistics Administration will be preferred;
  • Long relevant experience may replace educational requirements.


Experience

  • Ideally, 8 years of working experience within purchase, preferably from Supply Chain within the oil & gas or marine related industry;
  • Previous experience with ERP systems.

Knowledge

  • In-depth knowledge of the local supply market for the oil & gas industry and general knowledge to the international oil & gas supplier market;
  • Familiar with the terminology of the oil & gas industry;
  • Good understanding/knowledge of ERP systems;
  • Technical knowledge/understanding of the oil & gas industry is an advantage.
  • Advanced English (oral and written);
  • Understanding and knowledge of the technical, contractual, and commercial issues related to the design and engineering of Floating, Production, Storage, and Offloading vessels is an advantage.

title: Content Manager BR
description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Marketing at TRACTIAN:

The Marketing team at TRACTIAN crafts the narrative, defines messaging and positioning, and translates our groundbreaking products and features into tangible customer benefits. Our cross-functional team, spanning Product Marketing, Customer Experience, Growth, Branding, and Events, is dedicated to acquiring new customers and possesses a deep understanding of the business. We collaborate closely with a lot of teams to elucidate how we can help our clients reach their full potential.

What you'll do:

As our Content Manager, you’ll be responsible for driving our regional content strategy from planning to execution. This includes managing our editorial calendar, optimizing performance across key channels, and ensuring alignment with business goals. You’ll work cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Growth, and Sales to create high-impact content that supports inbound acquisition, ABM campaigns, and customer education.

This is a hands-on and strategic role, ideal for someone who combines editorial excellence, technical affinity, and a performance mindset.

Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the content calendar for Brazil across blogs, landing pages, partner media, newsletters, and outbound campaigns.
  • Develop and maintain a consistent pipeline of high-performing content assets that support the full funnel: awareness, education, and conversion.
  • Lead localization and adaptation of content created by the US and MX teams, ensuring cultural and technical relevance.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing and Sales to produce BOFU assets such as comparison pages, customer case studies, and playbooks.
  • Support ABM and demand generation initiatives with tailored content aligned with target accounts.
  • Track and analyze content performance metrics to inform future production and optimization.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external writers or partners to scale output without losing quality.
  • Partner with the SEO team to ensure all content supports our growth strategy and aligns with keyword opportunities.
,

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience managing B2B content, ideally in SaaS or industrial technology
  • Proven ability to lead editorial planning and coordinate content workflows across multiple teams
  • Strong writing and editing skills, especially in simplifying technical topics
  • Experience with SEO tools (e.g. Semrush, Ahrefs) and CMS platforms
  • Data-driven mindset, with experience measuring content impact on traffic, leads, and pipeline
  • Highly autonomous, organized, and deadline-driven
  • Advanced English
Compensation:
  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Education and courses stipend
  • Employee Giving
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years
  • Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance
  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation
  • Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.

description:
We're quickly growing and super excited for you to join us!

About Topsort

Today, Topsort has 5 major hubs worldwide, and employees in 13+ countries, including Menlo Park, Boston, Santiago Chile, Sao Paulo Brazil, Barcelona Spain, and Sydney Australia. We are a truly global company that was born in the pandemic that’s had rapid growth since out of a genius product, a customer-first mentality, and a hardworking team of talented individuals. Since our founding in 2021, we’ve gained customers in retail, marketplaces, and delivery apps in 40+ countries and quickly approaching the #1 position in the industry.

Do you enjoy a fast-paced environment? Do you like seeing your work create real-time impact, being part of a rocket ship from the very beginning? Let’s do the unimaginable - let’s make ads clean and cool again, with AI and modern technology.

What it’s like to work at Topsort

Our team is all about straightforward communication, embracing feedback without taking it personally, and fostering a super collaborative environment. It’s a sports team that’s hyper focused on winning, collaborative internally, and competitive externally - never the other way around. We thrive on working in the open, lifting each other up, and getting things done with a sense of urgency. We're the kind of team that loves making bold choices, sharing extraordinary opinions, and maintaining a 100 mph pace. No endless meetings here – if it can be done today, we're all about getting it done today.

About the role

We’re looking for aPassionate, Communicative, and Client-Facing hands-on Integration Engineer to join our fast-growing engineering team at Topsort! This is not just another engineering role —here, you’ll have the opportunity to take full ownership of integrations, working directly withcustomers to shape how our cutting-edge retail media API solutions seamlessly connect with the world’s leading retailers, marketplaces, and delivery apps.

Key Responsabilities

  • Own the entire integration process – You won’t just be following instructions; you’ll beleading integrations end-to-end , solving complex challenges, and acting as atrusted technical advisor to our clients.
  • Be the bridge between tech & customer success – Work directly with clients, engineers, and product teams to deeply understand their needs andensure seamless API integrations . Your solutions won’t just be functional—they’ll be impactful and user-friendly, strengthening long-term customer relationships.
  • Solve real-world challenges with agility – Debug, troubleshoot, and optimize integrations fortop-tier retailers and marketplaces , ensuring everything runs smoothly and efficiently. Your quick thinking and hands-on problem-solving will directly enhance the client experience.
  • Build stronger client relationships – This isn’t just a technical role; you’ll be theface of our engineering team in APAC , helping customers navigate their integration journey. You’llown key client interactions , build trust, andbecome a go-to expert for their integration needs.
  • Experience the world – This role comes with international travel opportunities, allowing you towork directly with global clients , visit their offices, and immerse yourself in different cultures. If you enjoymeeting people, collaborating in person, and making an impact globally ,this is the role for you!
  • Build smarter tools & automation – Developinternal tools and frameworks to streamline and simplify integrations, making them more scalable and efficient for future clients.
  • Career Growth & Leadership – As we scale, you’ll have the opportunity to grow into a leadership role andpotentially build your own team in the future .

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in software development.
  • Strong communication skills and experience interacting with customers and stakeholders.
  • Proficient in building integration tools and APIs.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs, data formats (JSON, XML), and authentication methods (OAuth).
  • Preferred experience: Experience in SaaS integrations or ad tech. Familiarity with customer relationship management (CRM) tools and integration platforms.
  • Availability to work 4 days per week onsite at our Sao Paulo Office.

Topsort Culture

Our team is all about straightforward communication, embracing feedback without taking it personally, and fostering a super collaborative environment. We thrive on working together, lifting each other up, and getting things done with a sense of urgency. We're the kind of team that loves making bold choices, sharing extraordinary opinions, and maintaining a 100 mph pace. No endless meetings here – if it can be done today, we're all about getting it done today.

  • Direct and Speedy: we move quickly, experiment boldly, and get things done today, not tomorrow. Feedback is candid, and the drive for constant improvement is part of our DNA.
  • Ideas > Titles: We believe the best ideas win, regardless of who they come from. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it.
  • Embrace a Sports Team Mentality: We're only competitive externally, and very collaborative internally. Everyone plays a vital role, and together, we win as a team.
  • Silicon Valley to the World: Founded by Stanford and Harvard alumni during the pandemic, we offer flexible working arrangements and (at least) one in-person offsite gathering per year to stay connected as a team.

Topsort is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Azure Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Azure Machine Learning Engineer role at Netrix Global .

Netrix Global is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer within the Professional Services – Data Intelligence department. The role involves researching, building, designing, and maintaining artificial intelligence systems responsible for machine learning. The engineer will also serve as a key communicator between data science team members, working with data scientists and operational teams.

About The Opportunity

The Machine Learning Engineer will be a vital part of the data science team, focusing on AI systems development and improvement.

About The Team

  • Remote work environment
  • Opportunities for skill expansion and cross-functional knowledge

How You Will Make An Impact

  • Design, build, and optimize data workflows for Machine Learning and GenAI solutions in cloud environments.
  • Develop and deploy models using Azure Machine Learning.
  • Manage data and model pipelines to enhance AI system efficiency.
  • Prepare data for AI and GenAI solutions.
  • Ensure integration of AI solutions within cloud architectures, including security and governance.
  • Test and document models and workflows for accuracy and performance.
  • Monitor and improve model performance in production.
  • Manage Data Lake architectures for ML and GenAI workloads (desired).

What You Will Bring To The Table

  • Experience as a Machine Learning Engineer or Data Scientist with skills in data pipelines and model development.
  • At least 2 years of experience working with Azure cloud services.
  • Proficiency in Python and ML libraries like TensorFlow or PyTorch.
  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure ML Studio, and other Azure data tools.

Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation role at Canonical

Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world's most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.
The role is a fast-paced, problem-solving role that's challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.
Location: This is a Globally remote role
What your day will look like

  • Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms
  • Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge
  • Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimize applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server
  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.
Joining Canonical, you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centers, from telco to retail.
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)
  • You have experience working with open source communities and licences
  • You have experience working with C, C++
  • You can work in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Experience with graphics stacks
  • Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST
  • Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments
  • Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience
  • IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services
  • Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s
What we offer you
Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.
In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.
  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Regional Corporate Counsel
A Regional Corporate Counsel specializing in corporate transactional work to provide expert legal advice and support for Epson's Industrial line of business, including strategic initiatives. Transactional Support:

Department Management

Legal Expertise
  • A Juris Doctor (JD) degree and admission to the bar (or Brazilian equivalent).

  • Strong negotiation and drafting skills, with the ability to effectively communicate legal concepts.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to handle complex legal issues.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.

Watch Our Story:' and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.
Toll Facility Market Lead
As part of HDR’s Highways and Roads market sector, the toll facility market lead will be responsible to support our local areas with the identification and development of projects and programs where HDR can bring our suite of professional services to toll facility clients. Toll facility clients include agencies and authorities that own, operate and maintain roads, bridges and tunnels that charge fees to users that travel on their facilities.
Toll facilities will be a sub-sector to HDR’s highways and roads market sector within the transportation business group. Services that the toll facility market lead will look to bring to these clients include:

  • Planning and Design services including, roadway, bridges, tunnels, transport hydraulics and geotechnical
  • Mobility and operational technology services including ATST, ITS, CAV, tolling system development and operations, managed lanes, ZEM and OT cybersecurity
  • Advisory services including asset management, ROW, value engineering, funding and finance
  • Building and facility design
The toll facility market lead will be responsible for the growth and success of tolling services and programs for toll road clients and will be expected to work with area business development leaders and business group managers to:
  • Develop and share knowledge of trends and drivers within the toll market
  • Support areas in the identification, pursuit and delivery of area toll facility client opportunities where HDR can compete and deliver professional services
  • Support areas in the research of toll facility clients in their markets and help develop client relationships that include local area teams and market sector teams
  • Support TBG region directors in the evaluation and prioritization of toll facility client investments and opportunities across their regions and the business group as the program expands
The toll facility market lead will be an individual with established relationships with toll facility agencies and authorities and someone with a reputation of leading programs in the highway/roads market.
This role will be expected to work with HDR leaders across the business group to broaden the range of toll services offered by HDR and to provide professional development for staff as they provide services to toll facility clients.
The toll facility market lead will be expected to support local area and business group leaders in the identification and participation of industry organizations that will contribute to the growth of HDR with toll facility clients and within the highway and roads market sector.
The toll facility market lead will lead HDR’s strategy for presence and leadership in industry organizations including IBTTA and others.
Preferred Qualifications

  • Proved ability to set the strategy and execute the strategy for growth of a practice, ideally in the Tolling market
  • Established relationships with major tolling clients/DOT's

  • A minimum of 10 years of industry experience
  • Experienced in development and management of strategic marketing programs for architecture, engineering and or planning services

  • Experienced in overall staff development to include recruiting, career path and professional growth
  • Experienced with industry associations and maintains a visible profile in the market sector
  • Ability to work cooperatively with Area Market Sector Directors, Market Sector Directors, Business Class Directors, Regional Business Group Director, Area Business Group Managers, Area Marketing Managers and Area Managers

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

Who we are?

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company with 61,000+ employees, approximately 1000 laboratories across 61 countries, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.

Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

The Team

Eurofins endeavours to develop all of our software applications in-house to service and support our numerous laboratories globally. With hundreds of thousands of clinical diagnostic tests performed every day, the laboratories of the Eurofins clinical diagnostic services business line strive to ensure that every patient, wherever he or she lives, has access to the most specialized and most innovative techniques for diagnosis, monitoring and therapeutic decisions. Such activities require extensive planning and organisation which can be augmented by the use of technology.

Our Clinical LIMS Europe Program will extensively be used as the central Laboratory Information Management System throughout Europe, this role is crucial in defining and delivering the product roadmap.

  • Assist in defining test cases and validating developed functionalities to ensure alignment with the approved requirements.

  • Conduct UAT testing to validate implementation of the requirements.
  • Analyse existing access control processes and recommend improvements for efficiency.
  • Ensure the solution adheres to IAM policies, procedures, and documentation.
  • Provide functional expertise in IAM tools and platforms, ensuring optimal configuration and performance.
  • Collaborate with Operations team to troubleshoot access management related issues as needed.
  • Conduct meetings, training sessions, and workshops for key users to ensure smooth adoption of systems.
  • Participate in requirement elicitation and understanding of other solutions within Identity and Access domain.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in IAM.

What we offer:

  • Very attractive, multicultural, and friendly work environment in fast-growing international company (more than 60,000 employees now)
  • Possibility to grow and take the next step in your professional career and self-development.
  • A launch pad into various opportunities – within many business lines of Eurofins globally.
  • A chance to become part of a highly motivated international team of professionals.
  • BE/ B.Tech /MCA or any other equivalent degree.
  • Proficiency in English is a must
  • 3-7 years of experience as a Business/ Functional Analyst.
  • Experience in UML, Visio, Draw.io to create domain model, activity diagrams to clarify requirements.
  • Experience with functional designs and tools for user journeys.
  • Experience with agile development and management platforms such as Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar.
  • Experience in User Training and delivering Application Demonstrations.

  • Eagerness to learn and develop both personally and technically.
  • Detail-oriented with strong interpersonal, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

About JumpCloud

JumpCloud delivers a unified open directory platform that makes it easy to securely manage identities, devices, and access across your organization. With JumpCloud, IT teams and MSPs enable users to work securely from anywhere and manage their Windows, Apple, Linux, and Android devices from a single platform. JumpCloud is IT Simplified.

About the Role

The Senior Data Engineer will have a crucial role on the Enterprise Data and Analytics (EDA) team, an internal, cross-functional analytics team that supports stakeholders across all company’s business units, including Finance, Marketing, Sales, Growth, UX, Customer Success, and Product. The primary responsibility of this role is to drive JumpCloud’s core reporting by developing data pipelines, curating and modeling data, and designing databases to enable insights and self-service across the analytics team and organization.

The Senior Data Engineer will collaborate with analytics teams (EDA, embedded analysts), technical teams (Enterprise Support Systems, Platform Engineering, Software Engineering), and business stakeholders to develop and maintain data pipelines, curated data models, and database designs that will support business and analytics insights throughout the organization.

The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic about data and continuous improvement. They will have the ability to balance and prioritize multiple projects, ask insightful questions in an ambiguous environment, and coordinate execution across various stakeholders. A proactive and hands-on approach is essential, as JumpCloud is a lean and fast-moving company.


What you’ll be doing:
  • Driving large, impactful projects involving data pipelines, database design, data modeling, and data curation for optimized analytics and business use with involvement across various stakeholders, business units, and technical partners.
  • Owning the outcomes of the analytics initiatives you’re leading. You’re not just a participant in the initiative, you hold yourself responsible for the outcome of the project.

  • Staying up-to-date on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in data engineering, database design, data modeling, and data governance and applying them to support our business needs.

  • Advanced knowledge and experience in SQL and relational databases; Snowflake experience highly preferred.
  • Advanced knowledge in database design, data modeling, data infrastructure, data pipelines, and ELT process to support analytics and business operations. DBT, Airflow, Fivetran, AWS, and GitHub experiences are highly preferred.
  • Advanced understanding of coding and markup languages and can create complex queries from multiple data sources, views, and tables and have an understanding of our company's data architecture and how to apply it.
  • Advanced understanding and experience with scripting languages such as Python (numpy, pandas).
  • Intermediate analytical skills and a passion for data storytelling and quantitative analysis.
  • Understanding in one or more business Intelligence / data visualization tools; Tableau experience highly preferred.
  • Strong mentoring skills.

  • Effective stakeholder management skills and communication skills.
  • Effective project management and organizational skills; Agile experience is a plus.
  • Experience with Data Governance best practices.

Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Marketing at TRACTIAN:

The Marketing team crafts the narrative, defines messaging and positioning, and translates our groundbreaking products and features into tangible customer benefits. Our cross-functional team, spanning Product Marketing, Customer Experience, Growth, Branding, and Events, is dedicated to acquiring new customers and deeply understanding our business. We collaborate closely with various teams to help our clients reach their full potential.

What you'll do:

As our Content Manager, you’ll drive our regional content strategy from planning to execution. This includes managing our editorial calendar, optimizing performance across channels, and aligning with business goals. You’ll work cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Growth, and Sales to create impactful content supporting inbound acquisition, ABM campaigns, and customer education.

This role combines editorial excellence, technical affinity, and a performance mindset, making it ideal for a hands-on and strategic professional.

Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the content calendar for Brazil across blogs, landing pages, partner media, newsletters, and outbound campaigns.
  • Develop and maintain a pipeline of high-performing content assets supporting awareness, education, and conversion.
  • Lead localization and adaptation of content created by US and MX teams, ensuring cultural and technical relevance.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing and Sales to produce BOFU assets like comparison pages, case studies, and playbooks.
  • Support ABM and demand generation with tailored content for target accounts.
  • Track and analyze content performance metrics for future optimization.
  • Coordinate with stakeholders and external partners to scale output without quality loss.
  • Partner with SEO team to ensure content supports growth strategies and keyword opportunities.

Requirements

  • 5+ years managing B2B content, preferably in SaaS or industrial tech.
  • Proven ability to lead editorial planning and coordinate workflows across teams.
  • Strong writing and editing skills, especially in simplifying technical topics.
  • Experience with SEO tools (e.g., Semrush, Ahrefs) and CMS platforms.
  • Data-driven mindset with experience measuring content impact on traffic, leads, and pipeline.
  • Highly autonomous, organized, and deadline-oriented.
  • Advanced English proficiency.

Compensation:

  • Competitive salary and stock options.
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses.
  • 30 days of paid annual leave.
  • Education and courses stipend.
  • Employee Giving program.
  • Opportunity to earn a trip worldwide every 4 years.
  • Up to R$1,000/month for meals and remote work allowance.
  • Health plan with national coverage without coparticipation.
  • Dental insurance for improved quality of life.
  • Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/month extra for activities.

Na MCS Markup todas as oportunidades são aderentes à diversidade e abertas a pessoas com deficiência! Valorizamos a singularidade de cada indivíduo e acreditamos que a inclusão enriquece nosso ambiente de trabalho.
Se você busca um espaço onde suas habilidades e potencial sejam reconhecidos, esta é a sua chance! Venha fazer parte de uma equipe que preza pela diversidade e pela igualdade.

Buscamos Consultor (a) de Due Diligence Sênior, para atuar em nosso time no Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo ou Remoto para demais localidades.

description:
Job description

Será responsável pela execução de trabalhos em processos de alta complexidade relacionados à TI, Segurança da Informação e Cibersegurança com o objetivo de elaborar relatórios de auditoria de maneira objetiva e independente. Deve também propor recomendações para melhoria do ambiente de controles internos nesses ambientes com soluções que permitam a eliminação ou redução dos riscos de perdas, bem como a proteção de seus ativos. Atender as necessidades de auditoria em todos os locais geográficos, lógicos e organizacionais em que o grupo TecBan ou seus parceiros de negócios atuam.


Main responsibilities

•Realizar entrevistas com pessoas chave para obter entendimento da estrutura de controles, riscos envolvidos e análise prévia do fluxo de atividades da área ou processo, indicando possíveis riscos e apontar eventuais controles não mapeados pela área;

•Elaborar relatórios descrevendo fatos, indicando riscos, causas e realizando recomendação de ações corretivas, visando a melhoria dos controles e do desempenho da área auditada;

•Elaborar e executar testes de auditoria para certificar a adequação e a efetividade dos controles dos processos ou atividades perante os riscos identificados;

•Revisar/apoiar a execução de teste, pontos de auditorias e relatórios preparados por auditores com menor experiência;

•Utilizar metodologia e padrões definidos pela Auditoria Interna aprovados pelo Comitê de Auditoria e indicados pelo IIA (The Institute of Internal Auditors);

•Manter-se atualizado em relação às técnicas, conceitos e métodos de Auditoria adotados, tanto no aspecto metodológico quanto tecnológico, contribuindo para análises dos riscos e embasamento dos apontamentos;

•Apoiar a supervisão no desenvolvimento de material de apoio e apresentações.

•Apresentar os resultados de relatório de auditoria ao Comitê de Auditoria, objetivando reportar os principais apontamentos identificados, bem como, as recomendações e plano de ação das áreas auditadas.

•Manter organizado e arquivado os papéis de trabalho de forma sistemática e racional, com o objetivo de contribuir no processo de programa de qualidade da Auditoria Interna. (Certificação IIA)

•Preencher a documentação de apoio e utilizar a ferramenta de Auditoria em todas as fases do trabalho indicando evidências e coletando os planos de ação indicados para a remediação do processo.

•Realizar follow-up regulamente para verificar junto às áreas auditadas se as recomendações foram implementadas com o objetivo de acompanhar a finalização dos planos de ação criados pelas áreas, mitigando os riscos apontados no relatório de auditoria.


Requirements and skills

Escolaridade

Curso superior completo, desejável, em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia, Administração De Empresas, Contábeis ou Engenharia.

Treinamentos/

Certificações

Desejável CISA, CISM, CRISC, CGEIT, CEH, CIA, CCSA ou CRMA.

Conhecimentos

Desejável no mínimo 5 anos de experiência em Auditoria Interna ou Externa, Cibersegurança, Segurança da Informação, Infraestrutura de TI, pentest, hacker ético, Desenvolvimento de Software e LGPD.

Conhecimentos em NIST, CIS, Cobit, ISO 27001, MITRE, COSO, Gerenciamento de Riscos e Controles, Normas Internacionais de Auditoria Interna, Pacote Office e Processos de Negócios.

Desejável Inglês avançado.

Competências

Bom relacionamento interpessoal e boa comunicação verbal e escrita.

Job Overview And Responsibilities
Are you passionate about transforming data into powerful insights that drive business success and being recognized for it?
Do you thrive on supporting users to solve complex problems using data visualization, analytics, and business intelligence tools?
Are you excited by the opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional teams and influence strategic decisions?

About The Job
We are seeking a skilled Business/Functional Analyst to bridge the gap between business needs and technology solutions. The ideal candidate will analyze business processes, gather requirements, and collaborate with stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery. This role requires strong analytical skills, excellent communication, and the ability to translate business needs into functional specifications.

Company Summary:

Recurrent Energy is a wholly owned subsidiary of Canadian Solar Inc. and is one of the world's largest and most geographically diversified utility-scale solar and energy storage project development, ownership, and O&M platforms. Recurrent Energy is focused on bringing low-cost clean energy and meaningful economic development to communities across the globe.

At Recurrent Energy, we believe in the power of teamwork to create a sustainable future. Join us as we work together toward a cleaner, greener tomorrow.

Reports To: Sr. Manager, Project Engineering

Location: Flexible hybrid model from our offices in São Paulo. In addition, traveling may be required to project sites.

Position Summary:

Recurrent Energy is comprised of an innovative, passionate, and hard-working team that is committed to making a difference and transforming the world with clean electricity. People are what make the company stand out. As a Project Engineer, you demonstrate the perfect combination of technical expertise and project management savvy.

You will lead the development, coordination and review of designs and technical standards for Recurrent Energy’s utility scale solar and BESS projects. At the core, as a Project Engineer you are an expert coordinator, bringing together stakeholders of every level for effective and profitable project deliveries.

Responsibilities:

Design Oversight

  • Develop, coordinate development, and review designs for Recurrent Energy projects (including permitting and construction support, customer care, and sales support).
  • Manage the work of engineering services providers and consultants.
  • Establish, maintain and improve technical specifications for Recurrent Energy facilities and equipment.
  • Provide technical support for interconnection in collaboration with transmission engineering team.
  • Support the performance and LCOE optimization process of Recurrent Energy projects.
  • Complete technical site assessment reviews and pre-design site visits.

Construction Support

  • Lead technical oversight during design and construction phases of the project, including value added engineering consistent with the required project specifications and requirements.
  • Provide engineering and QA/QC support to the project management team during project construction and commissioning.
  • Provide technical direction during startup, testing, PV system commissioning and performance monitoring.
  • Provide technical support for the review/preparation of client proposals and EPC/equipment RFP packages.
  • Participate in the evaluation and selection of EPC and main equipment suppliers.
  • Participate in the preparation, review, and negotiations of the technical exhibits for project sales, equipment procurement and EPC contracting agreements.
  • Attend factory acceptance tests for HV and electrical equipment.
  • Evaluation of PV products, emerging technologies and best practices in the solar EPC field.
  • Collectively responsible for project budgets of $100 – 500 million
  • Communicate and influence cross-functionally within Recurrent Energy.
  • Responsible for consultant scopes and associated costs.

Reporting Relationships & Interactions

  • Works cross functionally and collaboratively with all departments.
  • Manages consultant work orders to ensure scope, schedule, quality and coordination requirements are met.
  • Interfaces with third-party engineering service providers, and subcontractors.

Abilities

  • Problem solving skills: takes a systematic and proactive approach to solving problems. Actively seeks out issues rather than reacting to them as they come up.
  • Self-development: knows own capabilities, seeks out feedback and responds positively to constructive criticism.
  • Critical thinking: can break a situation down into smaller pieces to identify its key or underlying issues.
  • Flexibility: has the ability to work in a variety of situations, and with various individuals and groups. Understanding and appreciating different and opposing perspectives on an issue and adapting one’s approach to the changes at hand.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual will perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

title: Coordenador de Supply Chain, Varejo
description:
Description
Esta é uma vaga que tem o intuito de coletar talentos para posições futuras e é uma posição de contribuidor individual.

Description
Esta é uma vaga que tem o intuito de coletar talentos para posições futuras e é uma posição de contribuidor individual.
A Amazon Brasil valoriza a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas posições de trabalho, e por isso atuamos com intencionalidade para que nosso ambiente interno reflita a pluralidade dos mercados em que atuamos e clientes que atendemos. No Brasil , estruturamos um Comitê de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão composto por representantes de áreas e cargos diferentes pois entendemos que essa agenda precisa de diferentes perspectivas e vivências múltiplas. Nossa liderança é engajada e entende cada dia mais o seu papel na disseminação e prática dos nossos príncipios de liderança, com objetivo de sermos “a melhor empresa para se trabalhar do mundo”. Sabemos da nossa responsabilidade e necessidade de mudança e somos conscientes de que “ Sucesso e crescimento trazem grandes responsabilidades”. Nossos grupos de afinidade são formados por pessoas voluntárias de diferentes unidades de negócio e são parte ativa na definição das estratégias de DEI. Além disso, atuam como embaixadores dessa agenda e vão te apoiar desde o Day 1. Lembre-se “ it´s always Day 1”. Os grupos estão organizados nas seguintes frentes: BEN - Black Employee Network, , Glamazon (LGBTQIA+) e Pessoa com Deficiência.
Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) é um serviço que visa ajudar marcas e parceiros estratégicos a se desenvolverem de maneira sustentável com a Amazon. AVS ajuda os paceiros na Amazon a crescer de maneira sustentável, além de aumentar a disponibilidade e a descoberta de seus produtos. A Equipe de Especialistas Supply Chain é especializada em ajudar parceiros com desafios operacionais a alinhar melhor seus processos logísticos com a Amazon, analisar problemas de cadeia de suprimentos e desenvolver soluções sustentáveis para evitar perdas financeiras e trazer a melhor experiência para nossos clientes.Nesta posição, você reportará ao líder de gestão de operações de categoria e trabalhará para construir a estratégia de Supply Chain de contas chave. Você será responsável por liderar o planejamento de previsão de estoque, execução de compras e melhoria operacional de projetos, atuando como ponto de contato chave para gestão de estoque para um segmento de fornecedores. Você irá trabalhar na identificação de oportunidades de simplificar e automatizar tarefas, garantindo que sistemas e processos de inventário atendem às necessidades do negócio, implementando controles sobre estes. A pessoa ideal terá energia para lidar com ambiente em que atividades táticas e estratégicas acontecerão paralelamente.
Nesta posição, você irá gerenciar fornecedores de alta complexidade, trabalhando com autonomia para entregar o serviço. Você também será responsável por projetos de médio a alto impacto, atingindo especialistas de Supply Chain AVS em várias categorias de produtos e implementando melhorias de processos escaláveis para todo o varejo da Amazon.
Key job responsibilities

  • Análise da operação de supply chain utilizando dados e identificando as causas dos problemas operacionais (giro de estoque, lead time, reabastecimento, taxa de confirmação, forecast);
  • Definição de planos de ação conjunta com os parceiros para eliminar defeitos de Supply Chain e fazer revisões regulares de progresso com fornecedores para criar resultados sustentáveis de longo prazo;
  • Cooperar e construir um relacionamento de confiança em todas as funções e níveis de trabalho dentro da organização do parceiro (por exemplo, gerente de contas chave, gerente de Supply Chain, gerente de atendimento ao cliente), bem como na Amazon (Vendor Managers - gerentes comerciais, especialistas de contas chave, InStock Managers - gerentes de Supply Chain, gerentes de produto/programa, Equipes de Operações);
  • Preparação de revisões regulares de progresso para implementar soluções sustentáveis e resultados de longo prazo;
  • Organização e gestão de projetos com fornecedores sobre melhoria contínua/Kaizens;
  • Desenvolvimento de projetos internos para desenvolver ainda mais o programa AVS (por exemplo, planejamento de recursos, comunicação interna e externa, criação de mecanismos para soluções de problemas de toda a população de fornecedores, automação de relatórios etc.)
Basic Qualifications
  • Bacharel/Licenciatura (engenharia, administração ou áreas relacionadas à operações/cadeia de suprimento/logística);
  • Forte habilidade analítica, afinidade com números e habilidade de resolução de problemas;
  • Alto nível de auto-organização, priorização e gerenciamento de tempo;
  • Experiência sólida em gestão de produto/categoria, logística, gestão da cadeia e/ou de suprimentos;
  • Comunicação escrita e verbal em inglês avançada;
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de público sênior e influência de pessoas.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experiência com SQL;
  • Experiência com painéis de dados (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI, QlikSense);
  • Experiência com Lean Six Sigma, Kaizen;
  • Experiência com gerencimento de pessoas;
  • Experiência com análise financeira/qualitativa

description:

Customs and Border Protection Officer - Entry Level

Join to apply for the Customs and Border Protection Officer - Entry Level role at U.S. Customs and Border Protection

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

U.S. Customs and Border Protection provided pay range

This range is provided by U.S. Customs and Border Protection. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range

$40,332.00/yr - $109,952.00/yr

Customs and Border Protection Officer (CBPO)
U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) offers those interested in a career in law enforcement an exceptional opportunity to work with an elite team of highly trained professionals whose camaraderie, pride, and purpose are hallmarks of their daily mission of protecting America. You will be part of the Department of Homeland Security workforce, protecting American interests and securing our nation.
If you are looking for a rewarding career with great pay, benefits, and job stability, now is the time to make your move.
As a Customs and Border Protection Officer (CBPO) , you will be part of our 60,000+ workforce that strives to protect the American people by safeguarding our borders, deterring illicit activity, and enhancing the nation’s economic prosperity. Being a CBPO makes you a valuable member of the Federal Law Enforcement Officer (LEO) profession.
Typical Assignments Include

  • Enforcing customs, immigration, and agriculture laws and regulations.
  • Facilitating the flow of legitimate trade and travel.
  • Conducting inspections of individuals and conveyances.
  • Determining the admissibility of individuals for entry into the United States.
  • Preventing the illegal entry of individuals and prohibited goods and the smuggling of illegal drugs and other contraband.
Duty Locations – Incentives available for some locations
You will be asked to provide your preference for one of the following mission-critical locations: Nogales, and San Luis, AZ; Calexico, Los Angeles, Otay Mesa, San Francisco, San Ysidro, and Tecate, CA; Washington, DC; Miami and Orlando, FL; Atlanta, GA; Hagatna, Guam; Honolulu, HI; Chicago, IL; Calais, Fort Kent, Houlton, Jackman, Madawaska, Van Buren, and Vanceboro, ME; Detroit and Port Huron, MI; Baudette, Grand Portage, International Falls, and Warroad, MN; Del Bonita, Morgan, Raymond, Roosville, and Wild Horse, MT; Newark, NJ; Alexandria Bay, Buffalo, Champlain, Massena, Ogdensburg, Queens, and Trout River, NY; Dunseith, Hansboro, Neche, Pembina, and Portal, ND; Philadelphia, PA; San Juan, PR; El Paso and Houston, TX; Christiansted, U.S. Virgin Islands; Beecher Falls, Derby Line, Highgate Springs, Norton, and Richford, VT; Blaine Oroville, Seattle and Sumas, WA.
The preference locations listed above are expected to have vacancies available in the future, however, if the duty locations do not have vacancies at the time of your final offer, you may be offered a duty location in another geographic location within the United States. Locations offered are based on operational and mission requirements and critical agency hiring needs for entry-level CBPOs as determined by the CBP Office of Field Operations (OFO).
Salary – and Duty Location Recruitment Incentives – and Benefits
Annual Base Salary for newly appointed CBPOs varies as follows:
  • GS-5 and GS-7 $40,332- $109,952 per year
Locality pay varies by duty location.
Note: A fully trained CBPO is eligible for up to $45,000 in overtime pay in addition to the starting salary.
Grade level eligibility and salaries vary depending upon background, including experience and education, and duty location of the opportunity. This is a career ladder position with a grade level progression of GS-5, GS-7, GS-9, GS-11, and GS-12. You will be eligible for a promotion to the next higher grade level (without re-applying) once you successfully complete 52 weeks in each grade level. Promotions are at the discretion of the agency.
Officers are eligible to select from an array of federal employment benefits that include health, dental and other insurance plans, a generous annual and sick leave program, and participation in the Thrift Savings Plan, a retirement plan akin to a traditional and ROTH 401(k) offering.
LOCATION INCENTIVES: If you accept one of the duty locations listed below, you may be eligible to receive an additional 15%-25% of your salary each year for the first three (3) years of employment in addition to any overtime pay. If you accept the duty location of San Francisco, you may be eligible to receive an additional 25% of your salary each year for the first four (4) years of employment in addition to any overtime pay. These incentives only apply to new federal employees and are dependent upon the availability of funds.
Duty locations offering 25% recruitment incentives: Otay Mesa, San Francisco, San Ysidro, and Tecate, CA; Key West, FL; Calais and Jackman, ME; Detroit, MI; Grand Portage, MN; Raymond and Sweetgrass, MT; Dunseith and Pembina, ND; Beecher Falls, VT; Oroville, WA
Duty locations offering 15% recruitment incentives: Honolulu, HI; Portal, ND; Derby Line and Richford, VT; Blaine, WA
Duty location offering 10% recruitment incentives: Calexico, CA
Qualifications
You qualify for the GS-5 grade level if you possess one of the following:
Experience: A minimum of three (3) years full-time general work experience that demonstrates the ability to meet and deal with people and the ability to learn and be able to apply a body of facts;OR
Education Substitution: A bachelor's degree or successful completion of a full four (4)-year course of study in any field leading to a bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university;OR
Combination of Experience and Education: A combination of successfully completed college educationANDgeneral work experience. This will be calculated using your resume and official or unofficial college transcripts submitted with your application.
You qualify for the GS-7 grade level if you possess one of the following:
Experience: A minimum of one (1) year of specialized full-time work experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level that includes:
  • Performing physical inspections of people, documents or goods for criminal activity, fraud, and/or illegal operations.
  • Utilizing observational techniques, evaluating facts, and reviewing documentation while applying Federal, State, or local laws and regulations.
  • Making determinations in compliance with laws and regulations that may lead to arrests, seizure of property, fines, and/or penalties based on findings.
OR For The GS-7 Grade Level
Education Substitution: A bachelor's degree with Superior Academic Achievement based on (1) class standing, (2) grade-point average (3.0 or higher), or (3) honor society membership;OR one (1) full year of graduate-level education. This education must demonstrate the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to do the work;OR
Combination of Experience and Education: A combination of specialized work experience equivalent to the next lower grade levelANDgraduate level education from an accredited college or university. This will be calculated using your resume and official or unofficial transcripts submitted with your application.
If you have previous or current law enforcement or military law enforcement experience , you may qualify at the GS-9 grade level. See the GS-9 Job Opportunity Announcement (JOAs) at USAJOBS, the federal government’s official employment site to determine if you qualify.
Other Requirements
Citizenship: You must be a U.S. Citizen to apply for this position.
Residency: You must have had primary U.S. residency (includes protectorates as declared under international law) for at least three (3) of the last five (5) years.
Age Restriction: In accordance with Public Law 100-238, this position is covered under law enforcement retirement provisions. Candidates must be referred for selection to the Customs and Border Protection Officer position before reaching their 40th birthday in accordance with Department of Homeland Security Directive 251-03. The age restriction may not apply if you are currently serving or have previously served in a federal civilian law enforcement (non-military) position covered by Title 5 U.S.C. 8336(c) or Title 5 U.S.C. 8412(d).
Veterans’ Preference: You may also be eligible for an excepted service Veterans Recruitment Appointment (VRA). The age restriction does not apply if you are Veterans' Preference eligible.
Formal Training: You will be required to complete a paid pre-academy orientation for approximately two (2) weeks at your home port. You will then attend a 101-day training program – CBP Field Operations Academy – conducted at theFederal Law Enforcement Training Center (FLETC)located in Glynco, GA. This training consists of basic law enforcement skills, immigration laws, firearms training, examination of cargo/bags/merchandise, physical fitness, etc. Candidates assigned to the southern border, Miami, or Puerto Rico duty locations must attend and pass an online Spanish training program, which will be completed at their home port. Successful completion of the Academy is required for this position.
How To Apply
Click the Apply button on this site. You will be linked to the CBP Talent Network page. For Position of Interest , select Customs and Border Protection Officer.
You’ll then receive a link(s) to the CBPO JOA(s) on USAJOBS to complete your application. Be certain to review ALL details of the job opportunity announcement and follow all instructions in the application process, including items (resume, transcripts, etc.) to submit. You will be evaluated based on your resume, supporting documents, and the CBPO Entrance Exam.
As a subscriber to the CBP Talent Network, you’ll receive monthly emails with information about webinars, career expos, and future opportunities with OFO and CBP.

Job description

Fiscalizar e realizar o cumprimento dos padrões operacionais e de segurança que possuam o objetivo de inibição e redução das perdas da loja. Prevenir a ocorrência de pequenos furtos e desvios de mercadoria, zelar pela segurança física e patrimonial de colaboradores e clientes dentro da loja.


Main responsibilities

• Receber mercadoria, atuar no setor de recebimento de mercadorias, organizar o fluxo de entrada dos veículos de carga na loja, autorizar a entrada, acompanhar o descarregamento e a movimentação do motorista no interior do setor, autorizar a saída, fechar e abrir portões da loja;

• Estocar produtos, acompanhar os serviços de estocagem dos produtos recebidos, verificar se não há desvios de mercadorias, checar se não há movimentações estranhas no estoque;

• Repor, acompanhar a reposição de produtos na loja, com o intuito de evitar desvios e avarias nos produtos;

• Acompanhar a comercialização de produtos confinados, contar cigarros e bebidas (de alto valor), anotar as quantidades e solicitar sua reposição;

• Fazer a retirada e entrega do produto para o cliente, conforme a solicitação;

• Efetuar contagem e monitoramento de carrinhos com o intuito de evitar seus roubos;

• Monitorar as operações de modo a evitar furtos e desvios dentro da loja;

• Verificar autorizações, identificar e encaminhar visitantes ao departamento ou local desejado, registrando entrada e dados do visitante na falta de memorandos;

• Armazenar e organizar os pertences pessoais dos funcionários, tais como bolsas, roupas etc;

• Etiquetar todos os produtos comprados na loja pelos funcionários para consumo interno;

• Acompanhar movimentações na área de trabalho, observando acessos de pessoas em áreas restritas, restringindo o consumo de cigarros em áreas determinadas e observando possíveis furtos;

• Observar o estacionamento verificando os carros estacionados fora da área demarcada e comunicando ao departamento responsável para que o motorista seja chamado no alto-falante;

• Prevenir e evitar furtos, desentendimento entre clientes, algazarra e demais comportamentos inadequados;

• Monitorar os movimentos dos caixas, evitando e prevenindo possíveis crimes, atentando-se a clientes suspeitos e atitudes suspeitas das pessoas;


Requirements and skills

  • Necessário Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Será considerado um diferencial ter atuado na área de prevenção de Perdas e Fiscalização;
  • Será considerado um diferencial ter atuado no ramo alimentício - Atacadista, Hipermercados, Supermercados, Açougue etc.

CONTEXTO / DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Neste contexto a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL Distribuição em Fortaleza, implementando iniciativas de eficiência energética, reciclagem e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda. title: Show Review: Iceage at the Madonna Inn
description:
In the heart of San Luis Obispo at everyone’s favorite kitschy, pink hotel, Danish post-punk band Iceage graced the Madonna Inn’s Expo Hall.

Although the hall doesn’t share the same floral-lined carpets and cherub decor as the rest of the buildings, the charming grounds were a breath of fresh air after the drive up from Santa Barbara. I stepped into the dim lighting of the venue to be instantly surrounded by the crowd of SLO locals sporting jester makeup. Iceage was the opener for Orange County legends, The Garden, famously known for their iconic jester look, on their nine-date 2025 West Coast tour. This tour was also the first return of Iceage following their nearly two-year hiatus from playing in the US. Their last show here was a free New York concert in Central Park with a lineup of Matador Records artists that I must admit, I am quite jealous of — Iceage, Horsegirl, Lifeguard, and Water From Your Eyes.

I parked myself beside the stage, awaiting an experience I could only predict would be unparalleled. Throughout their five studio albums, they are both raw and refined, yet everything feels like their trademark. With punk roots, they expand to hardcore, goth-rock, Americana, country, with even a bit of gospel influence occasionally. Accompanied by some of the most clever, vivid, and emotionally ravaging lyrics with literary allusions you could delve into for days, their discography from the last 14 years is rather extensive, so I was eager to see what they would perform.

Having just seen Iceage’s vocalist, Elias Ronnenfelt’s solo show in a room of no more than 50 people in the summer, there was a heavy anticipation leading up to witnessing Iceage in all its glory. The solo set was extremely stripped down, just Ronnenfelt and his guitar (with the exception of a few backing track performances) playing his entire debut solo album, Heavy Glory , ahead of its release in October of 2024. He closed that set with respect to the many Iceage loyalists in the audience and played a few songs off their 2014 album Plowing Into the Field of Love .

That was the nearest I came to seeing Iceage live before this concert, but the wait was worth it to see the whole ensemble join together.

Johan Suurballe Wieth on guitar, Jakob Van Tsilling on bass, Dan Kjær Nielsen on drums, and Elias Ronnenfelt with vocals. These four men planted themselves on their respective corners of the stage, with Ronnenfelt being the least stationary of them all. Each of them had their respective looks that just made perfect sense to me. Nothing was too extravagant about their attire. Ronnenfelt wore a simple white button-up with a multicolored red, green, and black tie. Wieth had a trench coat and a cap, Tsilling in a white tee and a black vest, and Nielsen wrapped in a leather jacket. It simply matched my perception of them: cool, collected, and Danish.

They started strong with “Glassy Eyed, Dormant, and Veiled” and “Simony,” two of my favorites off Plowing Into the Field of Love . The opening song was raging and ominous, with a rhythm that set this almost uneasy tone in anticipation of what would follow. “Simony,” though more energetic, has these yearning lyrics that Ronnenfelt spewed with so much force that the song was completely reinvented for me.

He has a voice that sounds so disinterested, yet so earnest— you can’t help but die to hear what he has to say. It permeates through the noise on each record, but is elevated when he’s standing just a few feet away from you, swinging his arms and whipping around the mic cable like a leash with his tie mirroring the cord’s motions. With bangs in his eyes, he fastidiously mutters, “I do believe I am the Lord’s favorite one.” I don’t think I’ll argue with that!

Their setlist covered almost every base and played a couple of songs from every album, except their debut, New Brigade . I can forgive that with their inclusion of “High and Hurt,” which instantly ignited the room with a cathartic, unfiltered energy.

They gave a sneak peek of two unreleased songs, both having that same alluring Iceage charm and not entirely discernible lyrics, which is after all, part of the charm. Clips of these unreleased songs, “NY Banger” and “Lifetime,” have been circling for a while, but it was about time I heard them outside of a low-quality version on my phone.

After the set, I snagged a setlist, then the rush of adrenaline drove me directly to the merch booth to pick up their new tour merch. Their shirt featured a picture of Jakob Van Tsilling, their bassist, as a young boy holding a gun and a baseball bat. I was sold the shirt by no one other than Tsilling himself. After expressing my enthusiasm for their set, I took the opportunity to pick his brain.

Having just celebrated the 10th anniversary of Plowing Into the Field of Love , I was curious what his favorite song to play live off the album was. Any answer would’ve been the right one, but he responded with their title track, “Plowing Into the Field of Love.” My only critique of their set is that they did not include Tsilling’s favorite song, which is also a favorite for me. On the bright side, if you’ve been eagerly awaiting a new release from Iceage following their 2021 record, Seek Shelter , you’ll be relieved to know that he informed me that new music is in the works, and it shouldn’t be too long, and hopefully, a tour as well.

As someone jealous of Europe’s proximity to Iceage shows, I’m hoping the US gets thrown a bone or two.

The Garden closed with an invigorating set, even without their black and white makeup. Despite the number of times I saw them in high school, I was once again reminded how they always put on a memorable show. No matter how familiar you are with their music, you’re bound to remember their concerts fondly, even if you have what feels like a near-death experience in the pit. The twin brothers, Wyatt and Fletcher Shears, surge through every song with an unbridled energy, amusingly paired with their typically blank expressions. After I photographed them, I retired to the back of the hall to watch the tail end of the set with my friends. I spun in circles and was instantly transported back to the precise feeling of glee I can never shake when I hear them play.

Iceage opening for The Garden is not a lineup I could have conjured up myself, but I can say confidently that I was not let down. The entire night was this beautiful little moment of different musical eras of my life bridging together right before my eyes. Most of the audience was there to see The Garden, but judging by the looks of awe I witnessed of the people gripping onto the barricade during their set, it is safe to say that a few new Iceage fans walked away that night. -KD
