Se você é uma pessoa ágil, que encanta o cliente e preza pela excelência em resultados, venha fazer parte do nossotime !

Nós somos o Grupo NewChase e crescemos juntos!


Main responsibilities

  • Realizar atendimento ao cliente seja no showroom ou no digital/ligação, aplicando a metodologia padrão da montadora, através de uma postura simpática, entusiasmada e cordial com conhecimentos sedimentados dos produtos, identificando as necessidades do cliente e apresentando o mix de produtos e benefícios com o objetivo de garantir o fechamento do negócio e atingir as metas estabelecidas pela Diretoria Comercial.
  • Realizar vendas mensais, equilibrando volume, ISC (Índice de Satisfação do Cliente), lucratividade, acessórios, F&I e serviços, buscando atingir os objetivos do Grupo e os individuais.
  • Identificar as necessidades dos clientes e oferecer soluções adequadas, realizando demonstrações de veículos e test drive, negociando condições de pagamento, preços e prazo de entrega, com isso concretizando a venda e o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas pela Diretoria da área.
  • Realizar prospecção de novos clientes através de ferramentas digitais e/ou ligações, utilizando redes sociais, e-mails marketing e outras plataformas online para alcançar potenciais clientes e realizando chamadas ativas para leads qualificados, proporcionando um atendimento personalizado e consultivo.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências do mercado automotivo e características dos produtos oferecidos, para ser capaz de oferecer as melhores soluções de mobilidade, incluindo uma abordagem proativa na prospecção de novos clientes, através de ferramentas digitais e a prospecção por ligação.
  • Acompanhar e controlar, diariamente, a sua agenda, através do sistema corporativo de gestão de relacionamento com cliente.
  • Monitorar o funil de vendas, acompanhando todas as etapas do processo de venda, desde a prospecção inicial até o fechamento.
  • Analisar os dados do funil de vendas para identificar gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria, ajustando estratégias conforme necessário, segmentando os clientes de acordo com o estágio no funil de vendas, personalizando abordagens e comunicações para maximizar as chances de conversão.
  • Registrar, diariamente, no sistema corporativo todo histórico dos atendimentos realizados (telefone, e-mail, showroom, recepção, qualificação, apresentação do veículo, test drive, negociação, entrega, gestão de carteira e vendas que não foram efetuadas) com motivos e acompanhamentos, a fim de manter atualização e criar dados para análise de melhorias futuras.
  • Elaborar a proposta de venda, através do sistema corporativo, certificando que o produto esteja em estoque, trânsito e plano mensal, seguindo as orientações internas do departamento, visando fornecer ao cliente informações verídicas da negociação, promovendo sua satisfação e garantindo o resultado esperado pelo setor.
  • Acompanhar todo o processo da venda (emplacamento, instalação de acessórios, processo de veículo usado quando se aplicar), monitorando os pagamentos efetuados pelos clientes, para garantir o prazo de entrega negociado e preservar total satisfação do cliente.
  • Inserir todas as propostas e documentos do processo de vendas no sistema de arquivo digital corporativo, contribuindo para o funcionamento correto do departamento, considerando políticas internas do Grupo.
  • Acompanhar a entrega dos veículos vendidos, garantindo a satisfação do cliente.
  • Representar a concessionária do Grupo NewChase em feiras, eventos e lançamentos de novos produtos, promovendo os veículos e serviços da marca.
  • Monitorar as tendências do mercado automotivo, novas tecnologias e atividades da concorrência, identificando oportunidades de negócio e sugerindo ações para aumentar a competitividade do setor.
  • Realizar os cursos presenciais e via WEB da montadora e do Grupo, através do cronograma de cursos enviado pela Diretoria de Recursos Humanos, a fim de garantir a aprovação e manutenção do índice definido pela montadora.

title: Telecommunications Technician, Sr. - McMurdo, Antarctica (Austral Summer 2025)
description:
Note: If you would like to be considered for more than one position or position tier, please individually apply for all positions that you are interested in. One application submitted for a specific position does not automatically include you to be considered for all positions that you may be qualified to perform.

Job Purpose

Perform maintenance and repair of all inside and outside cable plant at USAP stations. The position is responsible for the maintenance and troubleshooting of the telephony systems for the station, fiber/copper cable plant for 1200+ users. The position provides critical required tasking such as fiber optic splicing, copper cable splicing and providing end user assistance with network and telephone troubleshooting and usage on the station.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Ensure that work areas meet all ASC and USAP safety standards.
  • Responsible for maintaining a safe workplace program and ensuring safety is the highest priority in the work place.
  • Provide phone system management.
  • Input cable and equipment data into Cable Management Software.
  • Assist communications Department with Black Island related events.
  • Survey all OSP cables and hardware for damage and schedule repairs as necessary.
  • Provide voice/data services to outlying field sites.
  • Provide support for testing and implementation of (802.11b) wireless LAN devices.
  • Install and repair Analog telephones.
  • Install and maintain inside and outside CATV, UTP, and Fiber distribution plant.
  • Install and maintain LAN cable drops & runs.
  • Maintain Automated Teller Machines and associated network equipment.
  • Update cable plant optical fiber and UTP as-builts.
  • Maintain Telco inventory and records.
  • Support Pair Gain DSL Systems.
  • Install and maintain all network transmission and distribution media, including twisted pair and optical fiber.
  • Maintain up to date cable records.
  • Update SOPs as needed.
  • Provide installation and maintenance support for HDSL transmission facilities.
  • Assist in annual departmental inventory and re-supply ordering.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • U.S. citizenship or permanent residency is required.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required. Continued education in technical courses pertaining to telecommunications electronics is preferred.
  • Minimum four years of experience in telecommunications systems is required.
  • Must be able to install, troubleshoot, and maintain OSP/ISP Fiber, OSP/ISP Copper, up to industry standards.
  • Experience with wiring standards and protocols required.
  • Solid understanding of logical and systematic troubleshooting techniques is required.
  • Excellent command of computers and software used in modern telecommunications facilities is required. Familiarity with the use of telecommunications test equipment, OTDRs, bit error rate testers and communications analyzers are required.
  • BICSI Installer Certification preferred.
  • Experience with Cable Management Software systems preferred.
  • Familiarity with electronics equipment cabling and standard installation wiring practices is required. Minimum two years' experience maintaining digital communications equipment preferred.

Competencies

  • Technical Capacity.
  • Organizational Skills.
  • Strategic Thinking.
  • Problem Solving/Analysis.

Physical Requirements

  • Deployment will be required in this position. The individual in the position must successfully complete physical and dental examinations as required by the NSF for deploying to Antarctica. Failure to meet these requirements may result in withdrawal of employment offer or other employment action.
  • Complies with applicable USAP/ASC safety, environmental, health, and waste management policies and procedures.
  • Individual must be capable of operating a standard desktop computer; must be able to lift and carry up to 10 pounds.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Position Expectations

  • This is a full-time, seasonal position located in Antarctica.
  • All expenses paid while deployed including meals, lodging, cold-weather gear, tools, and travel to/from Antarctica.
  • Candidate must be able to obtain a Public Trust Clearance.
  • Performance Period: October 2025-February 2026.

Job description

Buscamos um profissional para coordenar o desenvolvimento das etapas de exploração de um conjunto de projetos de exploração mineral da empresa, considerando planos de mapeamento geológico, geoquímica, geofísica, sondagem e estimativa de recursos e reservas, dar o suporte às equipes de Planejamento de Lavra de Longo Prazo no desenvolvimento de modelos geológicos e de lavra, desenvolvendo e aplicando metodologias e processos para geologia de longo prazo em interface direta com a equipe, avaliar eventualmente ativos externos e participar em visitas de terceiros para possíveis vendas ou negociações.


Main responsibilities

  • Assegurar a retenção, desenvolvimento, desempenho, treinamento, capacitação, solução de conflitos, comunicação e reconhecimento da equipe, conforme as diretrizes da área de Pessoas e Cultura.
  • Planejar e coordenar as atividades de projetos de exploração mineral da empresa.
  • Compilar, integrar e analisar os dados gerados pelas equipes de exploração para definir a sequência das atividades, em alinhamento com a Coordenação Geral.
  • Programar, acompanhar e executar sondagens prospectivas e de detalhe, com foco na cubagem de reservas minerais.
  • Reportar resultados estratégicos para a Coordenação Geral, Gerência e Diretoria da área de Exploração.
  • Participar da elaboração de relatórios técnicos exigidos por órgãos como a ANM (Agência Nacional de Mineração), além de relatórios internos mensais.
  • Revisar documentos e entregas das equipes de exploração, garantindo a qualidade técnica dos dados e produtos gerados.
  • Apoiar, quando necessário, a geologia de curto prazo das operações, atuando em interface direta com as equipes de geologia de mina e planejamento.

Formação em Geologia/ Engenharia geológica

Experiência consolidada com experiência superior a 10 anos aplicados à exploração e pesquisa mineral.

Domínio das melhores técnicas de pesquisa para diferentes tipos de commodities, principalmente minério de ferro.

Conhecimento em técnicas modernas de amostragem geoquímica, métodos geofísicos e sondagens.

Experiência em gestão de projetos, com foco em cronogramas, prazos e controle de custos.

Habilidade no processamento de dados geoquímicos, petrológicos e estatísticos aplicados à prospecção mineral.

Vivência em pesquisa geológica em ambientes greenfield , brownfield e em operações de mina.

Interpretação de dados geológicos em ambientes tridimensionais (3D).

Experiência com estimativa de recursos minerais por meio de softwares especializados (ex.: Leapfrog, Micromine, Datamine).

Conhecimento na elaboração de relatórios técnicos exigidos por órgãos reguladores, como a ANM.

Local de atuação: Vale do aço- Coronel Fabriciano

Liderança e habilidade para desenvolver e engajar equipes multidisciplinares.

Boa comunicação interpessoal e capacidade de troca contínua de informações com diferentes áreas.

Tomada de decisão com base em dados, com foco em resultado e visão estratégica.

Capacidade de atuar em ambientes desafiadores, com autonomia e responsabilidade.

Organização, disciplina e senso de prioridade para lidar com múltiplas demandas.

Flexibilidade para adaptação a mudanças e novas metodologias.

Proatividade na identificação e resolução de problemas técnicos ou de gestão.

Espírito colaborativo e habilidade para mediar conflitos e manter o clima organizacional positivo.

Lenovo is a US$57 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #248 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit , and read about the latest news via our StoryHub .

Description and Requirements

We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Global Process & Enablement Manager to lead and evolve global initiatives across Custom Fulfillment Services (CFS). In this strategic role, you will be responsible for optimizing core processes, driving knowledge sharing, enabling sales efficiency, and improving reporting and operational visibility.

This role requires someone who excels at connecting the dots across people, process, and technology — and is passionate about creating scalable, standardized, and automated solutions that enhance both internal efficiency and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define, document, and standardize end-to-end CFS processes across all regions to ensure operational consistency and scalability.
  • Complete initial global process documentation with structured quarterly reviews and updates.
  • Identify manual or repetitive tasks and collaborate with stakeholders to implement automation or AI-driven solutions.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with 100% of regional site teams across geographies.
  • Compile and manage a global CFS Best Practice Playbook, sharing practical process insights and regional expertise.
  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and evangelist for CFS, presenting CFS process improvements or strategic learnings with internal and external stakeholders
  • Design and implement automated tools (e.g., Power Apps) for tracking global part number usage, with real-time dashboards accessible by geo.
  • Collaborate with MSCT and Operations teams to produce actionable, leadership-level CFS dashboards and monthly reporting packages.
  • Ensure visibility of trends, KPIs, and escalations across senior stakeholders to support data-informed decisions.
  • Identify and resolve friction points in the sales cycle related to CFS quoting or delivery, driving measurable improvements in quoting speed or win rates.
  • Partner with regional Sales Enablement teams in North America and Latin America to deliver localized training and guidance aligned with market needs.
  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement and data-driven decision-making across the CFS organization.
  • Actively use the Business Management System (BMS) in partnership with regional leaders to surface and address systemic issues such as delays, fulfillment errors, or process breakdowns.
  • Ensure CFS operations consistently support a high-quality customer experience through reliability, responsiveness, and proactive issue resolution.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in project management, global operations, process improvement, or business program management.
  • Strong background in process documentation, workflow design, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Demonstrated experience with automation tools, reporting platforms (e.g., Power BI, Power Apps), and dashboarding.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and presentation skills.
  • Comfortable working across global time zones and diverse stakeholder groups.

Preferred

  • Experience with Service Delivery, fulfillment services, or adjacent supply chain/customer operations functions.
  • PMP, Lean Six Sigma certification or process excellence credentials.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese required, written and verbal. Spanish preferred.

title: Business Analyst / Requirements Engineer
description:
About Us

Zurich Insurance Company is a leading provider of insurance products and services, committed to delivering innovative solutions and exceptional customer service. Our ZCAM (Zurich Customer Active Management) team turns customer data into practical business solutions to drive the implementation of our ambitious customer strategy.

If you are a talented, dynamic and experienced Data Analyst, passionate about connecting the dots and have a strong background in technology, we would love to hear from you.

So make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported, Love what you do. Work with us.

The opportunity: Business Analyst / Requirements Engineer

As a Business Analyst, you will help ZCAM’s customers by understanding their needs and developing solutions to business problems. You will work with multidisciplinary and international teams to gather requirements, document processes, and communicate findings. Your responsibilities will include collecting and documenting business needs, analyzing data to identify trends and insights, suggesting process improvements, creating reports and presentations for stakeholders, and collaborating with teams to implement solutions. Additionally, you will be key to ensure that project objectives align with business goals, and will lead meetings and workshops to drive project success. Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills are essential for this role.

Responsibilities

  • Understands customers objectives, processes and products in order to make appropriate recommendations for customer-specific needs during incubation, delivery and operations
  • Plans, conducts and facilitates incubation sessions for business requirements gathering with subject matter experts and end users ensuring deliverables are met
  • Adapts and applies different delivery methodologies determining the best methodology for the specific project
  • Contributes to business cases, including cost / benefit analysis, risk assessment, project scope definition and development of a high-level schedule
  • Produces requirement specifications and outlines solution design documents throughout the project life cycle, incorporating change requests and finalization of requirements documentation
  • Analyzes and manages requirement risk, traceability matrix and prioritizes requirements
  • Performs quality review checks on project deliverables
  • Participates in development of test plan, testing, implementation and training activities
  • Participates in post implementation activities including problem solving and measurement of benefits achieved
  • Communicates effectively through different mediums at all levels
  • Creates compelling project documents such as business cases, including cost / benefit analysis, risk assessment, project scope definition and development of a high-level schedule
  • Manages interdependencies within the projects and other functions
  • Communicates effectively through different mediums at all levels

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering or science or a related field, any higher degree is an advantage
  • Professional experience in related role and/or demonstrated competency (projects) utilizing relevant technologies
  • Balanced mix of business acumen as well as affinity to technology and systems
  • Innovative and creative self-starter, highly motivated, business and IT savvy
  • Independent and able to handle multiple tasks and deadlines
  • Must possess in-depth, strong problem-solving analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Experience in the delivery of business solutions in time, quality, and budget
  • Proven experience as business analyst or subject matter expert in global projects and/or sound knowledge in insurance business
  • Proven track with project management & software development methodologies (e.g. Agile, SCRUM, ITIL, PMP)
  • Tough-minded, highly flexible and determine to deliver assigned targets
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills
  • Experience in application testing and organizing user acceptance testing
  • Customer-oriented team player with good communication abilities, fostering effective collaboration and teamwork
  • Strong proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required, Spanish language skills are a plus.

Additional Information

We look forward to receiving your online application.

Zurich wants to attract the best talent and we acknowledge that talents might not always be available full-time. At Zurich we will consider requests for flexible working. Many of our employees work flexibly in a variety of ways. Please talk to us during the interview about the flexibility you may need.

A Little Bit About Us
We are Belvo, an open finance API platform with the bold vision of democratizing access to financial services in Latin America. A Little Bit About Us
We are Belvo, an open finance API platform with the bold vision of democratizing access to financial services in Latin America. We enable any financial innovator to access and interpret financial data, as well as initiate payments from their end-users accounts. We’re turning the messy complexities of the Latin American financial ecosystem into a modern set of tools to access and interpret data and move money in a seamless and secure way.
We’re a highly-technical, passionate, and driven team. We are more than 90 people and our team currently represents 20 nationalities. We have offices in São Paulo and Mexico City – while a large portion of us work remotely.
We are tackling a very stimulating problem: connecting fintech innovators with legacy financial infrastructure. We strive to go beyond the limits of what is possible today and to do so in an elegant and developer-first way.
Since starting our adventure in May 2019, we have raised $71m from the leading VC investors globally.
You can read more about our company here and about our team and culture here. Also, head to our blog for more news about what we’re building and how we work.
About The Team

  • We work in cross-functional, autonomous teams. We follow continuous delivery best practices executed on top of a modern technology stack.
  • Our products are built for developers, by developers. Technological excellence is at the heart of what we do.
  • We are pragmatic and customer-focused. We strive to find the right set of trade-offs in order to validate our hypothesis as early as possible, iterating on our products based on customer feedback.
  • We communicate transparently. We do weekly all-hands where we get together to discuss company performance and goals.
  • While we are global and remote-friendly, we also operate from our vibrant offices in CDMX and Sao Paulo. To accommodate the various time zones in which we are based, we ensure we’re always synced up between 3 pm and 6 pm, CEST.
  • Also, we are backed by some of the leading investors in Silicon Valley and Latin America, including Founders Fund, Kaszek Ventures, and YCombinator.
Your Opportunity
  • Shape our AI strategy: Identify, prioritize, and execute on high-impact AI initiatives that accelerate company-wide efficiency and innovation.
  • Engage deeply with the tech: Rapidly build, test, and deploy internal tools and customer-facing features using the latest AI technologies.
  • Collaborate across teams: Partner with product, engineering, operations, and business teams to discover use cases and implement intelligent systems that solve real problems.
  • Bring ideas to life: Lead full-lifecycle development—ideation, prototyping, evaluation, iteration, deployment, and maintenance of AI services.
  • Embrace rapid learning and iteration: Embrace fast-paced cycles, quick experiments
This Position May Be For You If
  • You’ve contributed to building and maintaining LLM-powered systems in production settings.
  • You’re comfortable working with frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI SDKs, or PydanticAI and applying them in context.
  • You're familiar with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and its design considerations.
  • You integrate AI tools like agents or copilots into your workflow to improve productivity and efficiency.
  • You’re curious about new models and tools, and thoughtful about what’s practical for production use.
  • You bring solid engineering skills in Python (and ideally Django or FastAPI), and care about writing maintainable, well-tested code.
  • You value sharing progress early, collaborating closely with stakeholders, and view learning as an iterative process.
  • You bring 5+ years of experience in software engineering or building technical products.
  • You're fluent in English, written and spoken, and can clearly articulate technical decisions to diverse audiences.
Amazing If
  • Have previous experience in Fintech or SaaS product environments.
  • Have experience building agentic systems that integrate across tools and APIs.
  • Have worked in fast-paced or small-team environments where ownership and adaptability are important.
  • Have experience designing thoughtful evaluation approaches for AI features.
  • Have experience working with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures or vector databases.
Our Tech Stack
  • We’re building our platform using modern technologies, putting the focus on reliability and long-term maintainability
  • We primarily use Python on the backend. We use battle-tested technologies such as Django, and we are heavy users of Python’s asyncio for some parts of our stack
  • We use Javascript, Vue.js and Sass on the frontend. We are developing and leveraging our own design system and component library
  • We run our infrastructure on top of Amazon Web Services, leveraging managed services. We tend to favor the use of managed services wherever possible, in order to focus on our business problems
  • We observe and monitor our services using Datadog
  • We follow Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery best practices
Our Process Steps
At Belvo every hire is so important to us, that we share the decision to hire as a team.
  • People team chat
  • Take-home challenge
  • Challenge presentation
  • Manager interview
  • Meet the founders

description:
Join to apply for the Supervisor de Produção | Brasília role at Supergasbras Energia Ltda

About the Company

Supergasbras is part of the Dutch group SHV Energy, a global leader in Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) distribution with over 100 years of experience. Our mission is to deliver clean and efficient energy to millions of Brazilians across residential, commercial, industrial, and agribusiness sectors. With over 76 years of operation in Brazil, we are one of the country's leading LPG distributors, trading approximately 1.5 million tons annually with about 20% market share.

We develop projects focused on digital transformation, customer experience, innovation, and sustainable business development. Our strategy emphasizes trust and integrity to become Brazil's best energy company for our customers, partners, employees, and shareholders, with a commitment to social and environmental responsibility.

At Supergasbras, diversity and inclusion are business priorities. We value and believe in the development of people both professionally and personally, promoting gender equity, including people with disabilities, respecting all sexual orientations, and fighting racial discrimination at all levels of society.

Being diverse is being Super!

Responsibilities and Duties

Job Objective

Responsible for the production of LPG bottling in P13 / P20 / P45 packages, logistics for serving resellers and bulk customers across DF and surroundings, industrial maintenance of the bottling unit, QSMS of the unit, LEAN and people management of a team of 100 employees.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise activities related to bottling and storage of LPG.
  • Use of Lean tools (problem solving, performance management, GEMBA, 5S).
  • Monitor operational KPIs of the unit.
  • Manage technical and legal documents (ISO 9001).
  • Control attendance of direct employees.
  • Manage inventories of full and empty bottles and LPG to ensure reliability and operational needs.
  • Promote team engagement and development.
  • Implement and maintain safety and environmental procedures, fostering a safety culture.
  • Participate in internal and external audits related to operational activities.
  • Train production team for safe and effective operation.
  • Ensure proper recording and control of production data, batch traceability, and compliance with ANP and other regulatory standards.
  • Support quality department in handling non-conformities related to the production process.
  • Conduct operational and alignment meetings with logistics, maintenance, quality, and safety teams.

Requirements and Qualifications

Mandatory Requirements

  • Complete higher education in Mechanical, Electronic, Civil, Electrical, Aerospace, or Production Engineering.
  • Intermediate English proficiency.
  • Intermediate/advanced proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).

Desirable Requirements

  • Knowledge of Power BI.

Additional Information

At Supergasbras, we recognize and support our employees with excellent benefits and programs.

  • Health & Well-being: Medical, Dental, and Gympass.
  • Food Benefits: Meal vouchers and on-site restaurant.
  • Financial Planning: Profit sharing and private pension.
  • Family: Extended maternity/paternity leave.
  • Development: Corporate University and Learning programs.
  • Celebrations: Birthday leave.
  • Other Benefits: Exclusive perks.

By applying, you accept our Privacy Policy available at this link .

What makes us Super?

We value people and everything they bring: ideas, contribution, partnership, and collaboration. We strive to create a work environment that fosters human and professional development, encouraging interaction, active participation, and growth. We believe success comes from collective energy and collaboration.

What exactly do we do?

As part of the SHV Energy Group, a global LPG distributor and one of Brazil's leading gas companies with over 75 years of experience, we operate the most modern bottling plant in Latin America and have over 20 industrial units nationwide. Our over 4,000 employees are proud to serve more than 10 million Brazilian families and over 60,000 business clients, from small shops to large industries, including agribusiness.

Join us and be Super!

Business Analyst / Requirements Engineer

About Us

Zurich Insurance Company is a leading provider of insurance products and services, committed to delivering innovative solutions and exceptional customer service. If you are a talented, dynamic and experienced Data Analyst, passionate about connecting the dots and have a strong background in technology, we would love to hear from you.

So make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported, Love what you do. Work with us.

The opportunity: Business Analyst / Requirements Engineer

As a Business Analyst, you will help ZCAM’s customers by understanding their needs and developing solutions to business problems. You will work with multidisciplinary and international teams to gather requirements, document processes, and communicate findings. Your responsibilities will include collecting and documenting business needs, analyzing data to identify trends and insights, suggesting process improvements, creating reports and presentations for stakeholders, and collaborating with teams to implement solutions. Additionally, you will be key to ensure that project objectives align with business goals, and will lead meetings and workshops to drive project success. Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills are essential for this role.

  • Contributes to business cases, including cost / benefit analysis, risk assessment, project scope definition and development of a high-level schedule
  • Produces requirement specifications and outlines solution design documents throughout the project life cycle, incorporating change requests and finalization of requirements documentation

  • Performs quality review checks on project deliverables

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering or science or a related field, any higher degree is an advantage
  • Professional experience in related role and/or demonstrated competency (projects) utilizing relevant technologies
  • Balanced mix of business acumen as well as affinity to technology and systems
  • Innovative and creative self-starter, highly motivated, business and IT savvy
  • Independent and able to handle multiple tasks and deadlines
  • Must possess in-depth, strong problem-solving analytical skills with attention to detail

  • Good interpersonal and communication skills

  • Customer-oriented team player with good communication abilities, fostering effective collaboration and teamwork

Additional Information

We look forward to receiving your online application.

Zurich wants to attract the best talent and we acknowledge that talents might not always be available full-time. At Zurich we will consider requests for flexible working. Many of our employees work flexibly in a variety of ways. Please talk to us during the interview about the flexibility you may need.

Job description

O CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados abrangem toda a população carioca, residente da cidade. É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

A unidade de saúde é preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

·diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas;

·realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual;

·avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual;

·programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão;

·ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde.

·realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Coordenar a fim de garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e, das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade. Acompanhar, analisar e tratar os relatórios e atendimentos necessários para o cumprimento das metas, prazos e melhorias.


Main responsibilities

Realizar atividades na especialidade de oftalmologia, prevenir, diagnosticar e tratar das doenças e distúrbios dos olhos e visão, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal de Saúde.


Requirements and skills

Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina. Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista em Oftalmologia. Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico Oftalmologista;

Especialista em Segmento Posterior com comprovante de Estagio (Fellowship) em Segmento Posterior ou Carta de Serviço ou Especialista na Área.

description:
The Business Unit Leader leads their team towards success in creating sustainable people, profit, and planet value, by adopting the following roles:

1. Member of the Operations team

The Business Unit Leader aspires to drive the performance of the Shop first, even before their own Business Unit. They are actively involved in:

  1. Sharing best practices between Business Units and contributing to Plant performance in a collaborative manner, maintaining a "ONE MANUFACTURING TEAM" mindset.
  2. Detecting and developing talents to grow their careers in the Shop, exporting talent to support business needs.
  3. Supporting Shop decisions even under uncertainty and unfavorable circumstances.
  4. Improving Business Unit performance through coaching and feedback.
  5. Providing input on support team members' performance and development recommendations.

2. People developer

The Business Unit Leader is passionate about developing people, viewing their plant as a platform for recruitment, training, and professional growth. They are expected to:

  1. Promote a lifelong learning mindset by evaluating competencies and identifying development opportunities.
  2. Ensure development through Spoke training and social promotion projects.
  3. Utilize accessible career paths for all employees.
  4. Build and believe in diverse teams.
  5. Support competency development via mentoring and coaching.

3. Representative/Role model of Company values, purpose & strategy

The Business Unit Leader embodies the group's values and represents the Plant to employees by:

  1. Living out values and inspiring through behavior.
  2. Motivating teams using Michelin purpose & Dream.
  3. Ensuring understanding of the Plant strategy and individual roles in collective success.
  4. Aligning the shop vision and engaging teams to realize it.
  5. Addressing employee issues timely and ensuring accurate attendance records.
  6. Developing Safety as a core value, ensuring responsibility for safety among employees.

4. Customer & business partner

The Business Unit Leader understands customer needs and guides teams to be customer-centric. They are expected to:

  1. Understand customer requirements and their role in meeting expectations.
  2. Focus on all aspects of economic value creation.
  3. Support business through collaboration on industrialization, digitalization, and industry transformations.

5. Environment promoter

The Business Unit Leader promotes sustainability and environmental impact reduction by:

  1. Fostering a culture valuing sustainability and environment.
  2. Implementing strategies for environmental impact and biodiversity.

CARE AREA of EXCELLENCE

6. ICARE & Empowerment role model

Leading with the ICARE leadership model, inspiring and coaching teams to progress by:

  1. Inspiring passion for ICARE at all levels.
  2. Creating inclusive, safe, collaborative, and intelligent team environments.
  3. Fostering empowerment and engagement in plant evolution and transformation.

7. Operational Excellence Leader

Developing operational excellence by ensuring:

  1. Activities apply MMW practices, creating sustainable foundations for performance.
  2. Continuous progress through variation and non-value tasks reduction.
  3. Achievement of SMQDC performance levels and standards compliance.
  4. Team empowerment, increased autonomy, and responsibility.
  5. Effective problem-solving to eliminate root causes.

TECH AREA of EXCELLENCE

8. Digital and Innovation contributor

Driving innovation, engineering, and technology transformation by:

  1. Encouraging digital application use and data-driven approaches.
  2. Building foundations for transformation (data quality, skills, organization, roadmap).
  3. Supporting projects that develop capabilities aligned with Michelin strategy, promoting digital best practices.

O Hub Digital faz parte da nossa área de Estratégia e Tecnologia, tendo papel de destaque na nossa transformação em uma empresa media tech e D2C. Aqui cuidamos da gestão de dados e do desenvolvimento dos nossos produtos digitais como Globoplay, Globo.com, família G (G1, Ge, Gshow) e Cartola, visando a melhor experiência de consumo, interação e relacionamento com os nossos usuários.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Responsibilities and assignments
Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Apoiar a definição e a manutenção do framework de eventos (Ex: GA4, GTM, Amplitude), promovendo reuso e padronização na coleta de dados entre produtos e squads;

  • Trabalhar em colaboração com stakeholders das áreas de produto, marketing, tecnologia e dados, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em estratégias de mensuração consistentes;

  • Apoiar a integração de ferramentas de mensuração com plataformas de dados e marketing, promovendo interoperabilidade e consistência nas entregas;
  • Conduzir análises exploratórias e recorrentes com foco em comportamento do usuário, eficiência de funcionalidades e identificação de oportunidades;
  • Fomentar a cultura orientada a dados, promovendo boas práticas, capacitação técnica e troca de conhecimento entre os profissionais alocados em diferentes frentes.

Requirements And Qualifications
Do que você precisa:
  • Experiência sólida com ferramentas de mensuração digital, como Google Analytics 4 e Google Tag Manager;
  • Vivência na implementação e manutenção de estruturas de eventos e tags em ambientes com múltiplos produtos ou squads;

  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados como Looker, Looker Studio (Data Studio) ou similares;

  • Experiência em atuação em estruturas de plataforma ou áreas de competência (chapter, center of excellence);
  • Vivência com governança de eventos, taxonomias e documentação técnica em escala;

At Bunge, people don’t just come here to work, they come here to grow – solving challenges that directly impact the world with a diverse and talented team working to make us the most innovative and dynamic company in our industry.Bunge offers a strong compensation and benefits package and most importantly, in all we do we live our values:

Act as One Team by fostering inclusion, collaboration, and respect
Drive for Excellence by being agile, innovative and efficient
Do What's Right by acting safely, ethically, and sustainably

Overview


The Security Analyst I serves as Tier 1-2 Analyst member of the Bunge Global SOC and all operational activities that serve to protect the confidentiality, integrity and security management of business and employee information and systems in compliance with organization policies and standards. He/she will focus on structured tasks associated with proactive response, initial identification and remediation of suspicious network and host based activity. The successful candidate will have significant and demonstrated skills in the areas of: TCP/IP protocols; malware and virus behavior. The candidate should display strong technical depth that spans PC and server software, application and custom code. A solid technical background in computer vulnerabilities, attack vectors and exploits is required.

Essential Functions


Perform as part of the CTDO group, initial analysis, triage and response tasks of cyber events with the security team to operate a global SOC for Bunge to safeguard the company's assets, intellectual property and information systems.
Conduct Tier 1 SOC activities to collect, store, and correlate, analyze, identify and respond to security data derived from sensors.
Implement, configure, and optimize the detection and reporting capabilities of company’s global security tool suite.
Collect and analyze intrusion artifacts (e.g., event logs, source code, malware) and use discovered data to support incident response actions.
Conduct rapid incident response activities and cyber event investigations.
Conduct a level of critical thinking as it relates to root cause analysis of actual or suspected security incidents recommended corrective actions.
Provide and or contribute to the development of ad-hoc information security reports to be shared with the Information Security Working Group and other executive leadership, as required

Qualifications


Preferred candidate has 1-4+ years’ experience in the Information Technology field
Minimum of 2+ years of direct experience in Cyber Security, SOC operations, Incident Response, and Security tool integration & operations is required.
1+ years direct experience with Splunk, Fidelis, Falcon Host, Firewall and IDS/IPS technologies preferred.
1-2+ year in any position: system administrator, application developer, database administrator, LAN administrator.
Associate or Bachelor’s degree of Science in computer science, information systems, engineering, or programming
Industry recognized certifications such as, GSEC, GCIA, CEH. CISCO a plus
Intermediate scripting knowledge in Perl, PHP, ASP or Java with recent and basic programming experience as a plus
Minimum of 2 years of experience in compliance-oriented industry is preferred.
Advanced understanding and demonstrated technical skils and abilities in the technical information security operations domain
Ability to conduct analysis of multiple data sources and provide assessment on the relationship between threats, vulnerability and information value in the context of risk management for company.
Bi-lingual/Multi-lingual candidates preferred: English Advanced Spanish (Plus).
Solid understanding of the concept of risk-based decision-making (i.e. risk analysis, mitigation, resolution)
Ability to perform high-quality work, work with minimum supervision and deliver results in timely manner.
Must be able to communicate effectively regarding security, privacy, risk, and compliance to senior business leaders and fellow team members.
Able to draw upon proven experience to rapidly assimilate, understand, evaluate and recommend response actions to a variety of cyber events. He/she must be able to work with others in formal and ad-hoc team environments.
Demonstrated ability to configure, maintain and use core tools SPLUNK, Carbon Black or Fidelis.
This individual will have the proven ability to conduct event analysis and correlation; establish facts and deliver conclusions/recommendation under extremely short timelines.
Improve Bunge's outcomes by making data-driven decisions, keeping the customer at the forefront of all they do, and proactively gaining insight into the global strategy.
Collaborate, effectively communicate with others and take initiative to continually develop themselves.
Pursue opportunities to solve problems and take action while maintaining the ability to manage work, even in times of challenge or change.

Bunge (NYSE: BG) is a world leader in sourcing, processing and supplying oilseed and grain products and ingredients. Founded in 1818, Bunge’s expansive network feeds and fuels a growing world, creating sustainable products and opportunities for more than 70,000 farmers and the consumers they serve across the globe. The company is headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri and has 25,000 employees worldwide who stand behind more than 350 port terminals, oilseed processing plants, grain facilities, and food and ingredient production and packaging facilities around the world.

  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de desempenho de manutenção (KPIs) para identificar oportunidades de melhoria.

title: Legal Coordinator
description:
Sobre a Enter

A Enter foi fundada em 2023 com a missão de tornar o Brasil um protagonista em Inteligência Artificial. Unimos a expertise humana à eficiência da IA para ajudar grandes empresas da América Latina a otimizar processos críticos de alto volume e que exigem intenso trabalho manual. Iniciamos nossa jornada aplicando IA para criar defesas jurídicas personalizadas em larga escala, permitindo que grandes empresas reduzam custos advocatícios e aumentem suas taxas de êxito. Atendemos clientes como Nubank, Latam, Banco BMG, iFood, SulAmérica, Banco Inter, Banco C6, entre outros.

A Vaga

A Enter está na interseção de três pilares fundamentais: grandes empresas, os escritórios de advocacia parceiros que conduzem as ações judiciais, e nossa plataforma de inteligência artificial, que impulsiona a eficiência e a precisão de todo o processo jurídico.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Coordenador(a) Jurídico(a) para atuar como elo estratégico e operacional entre esses três grupos. Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a qualidade e consistência das entregas dos escritórios parceiros, monitorando produtividade e assegurando que os processos estejam alinhados com os padrões da Enter.

O sucesso nessa função depende da sua capacidade de estruturar e manter um fluxo de trabalho eficiente e colaborativo, integrando nossa tecnologia ao dia a dia jurídico e assegurando que o valor gerado pela plataforma de IA chegue com excelência aos nossos clientes.

Responsabilidades

  • Se tornar o elo operacional entre nossa rede de advogados parceiros, nossos líderes de produto e as equipes jurídicas dos nossos clientes.
  • Estar à frente de diversos requisitos operacionais relacionados ao nosso modelo verticalizado, incluindo o acompanhamento de prazos-chave, coleta de dados e conteúdos necessários dos clientes para otimizar nosso trabalho jurídico.
  • Aplicar rigor intelectual jurídico para avaliar nossa eficiência na elaboração das melhores defesas possíveis para nossos clientes.
  • Construir o playbook operacional deste produto do zero, de forma que ele possa ser replicado em produtos futuros além do contencioso de massa.

O que valorizamos

  • Profissionais que não se contentam com respostas superficiais e mergulham nos detalhes.
  • Baixa necessidade de reconhecimento individual, priorizando o resultado acima do crédito pessoal.
  • Capacidade excepcional de enfrentar problemas abertos em ambientes não estruturados.
  • Disposição para aprender, orientar, liderar e seguir conforme necessário.
  • Senso de urgência desproporcional, mantendo em mente a escalabilidade e a criação de processos replicáveis para garantir o sucesso a longo prazo.
  • Pessoas curiosas e que conseguem aprender coisas difíceis rapidamente.

Requisitos

Idealmente, você tem:

  • Pelo menos 3 a 5 anos de experiência na área jurídica, seja atuando diretamente como advogado(a) ou como figura operacional dentro de uma operação jurídica ou equipe jurídica interna de uma empresa.
  • Experiência em liderar ou coordenar times multifuncionais, incluindo profissionais do Direito, para alcançar resultados em escala.
  • Capacidade de organização, atenção aos detalhes e senso de priorização.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidades de gestão de projetos, com interesse em liderar e desenvolver outras pessoas dentro da equipe.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com a operação interna de escritórios de advocacia que lidam com contencioso de massa no Brasil.
  • Histórico comprovado de liderar relacionamentos de trabalho com stakeholders em grandes empresas e de entregar valor de forma consistente.

  • Apresentar regularmente os resultados das análises para a gerência e equipes comerciais;

  • Gestão de banco de dados;
  • Estatística;
  • Analise visualização dedos

Join to apply for the Product Manager, Dental role at Guardian Life

The Dental Product Manager plays a key role in developing, supporting, implementing and managing our dental insurance products to meet market needs, drive growth, and enhance member value. Habilidade na gestão de resíduos e controle de poluição em canteiros de obras.

Experiência na elaboração de relatórios técnicos e no cumprimento de condicionantes ambientais.

Disponibilidade para atuar em campo e em diferentes projetos de obras.

description:
Job Description
Trabalhar com as equipes de vendas, marketing, aplicações tecnológicas e serviços nas oportunidades de negócios identificadas, monitorando a execução de planos de negócios adaptados aos diversos cenários culturais e econômicos da América Latina.

Job Description
Trabalhar com as equipes de vendas, marketing, aplicações tecnológicas e serviços nas oportunidades de negócios identificadas, monitorando a execução de planos de negócios adaptados aos diversos cenários culturais e econômicos da América Latina.
Identificar, classificar, planejar e implementar estratégias e ações adequadas à maturidade dos mercados-alvo e contas, independentemente de as contas estarem em fase de "aquisição" ou "em desenvolvimento".
RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Propor e implementar estratégias abrangentes de desenvolvimento específicas para os mercados atribuídos, a fim de atingir os objetivos comerciais na região, com base em análises de mercado, concorrência, portfólio de soluções, ecossistema de canais, histórias de sucesso e propostas de valor da Vertiv.
  • Realizar pesquisas de mercado para identificar tendências, necessidades dos clientes e dinâmicas competitivas nos mercados atribuídos na América Latina.
  • Alinhar as estratégias com os objetivos globais da empresa, abordando, ao mesmo tempo, as nuances locais.
  • Identificar e buscar novas oportunidades de negócios nos mercados atribuídos, avaliando novas parcerias, joint ventures e canais de distribuição.
  • Implementar a estratégia de entrada nos mercados/territórios atribuídos, garantindo a cobertura das contas e mercados-alvo para atingir as vendas de produtos e serviços da Vertiv.
  • Implementar a estratégia de desenvolvimento de mercado/território, garantindo o posicionamento da marca para atingir as vendas de todas as linhas de produtos e serviços disponíveis da Vertiv.
  • Liderar esforços de inteligência de mercado para identificar leads e, com o apoio das equipes de marketing e vendas, desenvolver esforços de posicionamento da marca nos segmentos industriais atribuídos.
  • Estabelecer e manter relacionamentos entre a Vertiv e as principais partes interessadas, incluindo entidades governamentais, associações e parceiros comerciais, para facilitar a comunicação, a cooperação e o desenvolvimento do setor.
QUALIFICAÇÕES
Qualificações Mínimas Para o Cargo
  • 5 anos de experiência no setor em operações de vendas, vendas ou marketing.
  • Sólido conhecimento da dinâmica e arquitetura de infraestrutura de setores como Mineração e Materiais, Energia (Óleo e Gás, Serviços Públicos, Energias Renováveis), Saúde, Manufatura, Transporte, Varejo, Serviços Financeiros e Bancos, Educação, Governo, Educação e/ou Telecomunicações.
  • Habilidades excepcionais de comunicação e capacidade de construir relacionamentos diversificados interna e externamente.
  • Habilidades analíticas para identificar mercados com maior potencial e compreender o impacto das mudanças de mercado e da concorrência à medida que afetam um portfólio de produtos.
  • Nível intermediário de inglês (avançado preferencialmente)

This job is with Accenture, an inclusive employer and a member of myGwork – the largest global platform for the LGBTQ+ business community. Please do not contact the recruiter directly.
Role Overview
With the passion of our people, our technology expertise and a broad ecosystem of partners, Accenture is committed to being a sustainable and responsible business, innovating for positive societal and environmental impact, developing and scaling programmes and solutions that help address big challenges for people and planet.
From a Corporate Citizenship perspective, we are currently looking for a passionate and enthusiastic team player to join us as our Collaboration support analyst. This role is designed to lead the on/off boarding process for all new joiners/leavers in the Corporate Citizenship Network, support the engagement activities to strengthen connections and foster collaborations and act as central point of contact to manage general questions and requests from all the team.
The Sr. Analyst will support the Corporate Citizenship in the following areas:
Essential Priorities
Foster Connections and collaboration to increase our Social Impact (support coordination of learning virtual sessions and management of a new regular newsletter for the team).
Through the coordination and delivery of key engagement sessions and communications targeting our entire Corporate Citizenship Team, this role will serve as the central force that brings the team together, creates learning opportunities, and fosters collaboration, knowledge exchange, and connections.
Strengthen engagement, and sense of belonging while establishing and continue building the foundation of our Team Culture and offering learning opportunities (On/Off boarding Process, and CC Mailbox/Accenture Direct questions Management)
This role will support activities aimed at building a strong foundation to enhance the sense of belonging within the team. In addition, it will be essential for this role to serve as a key point of contact (PoC) for our teammates, providing answers to their questions and offering support.
Production of summary updates /presentations, Global Subscriptions management and content management (CC Shared Mailbox, content update and maintenance, support the creation of key ad-hoc presentations and global subscriptions management, and maintenance of SharePoint and MS Teams)
Supporting the creation of engaging and visually appealing slides and presentations for our various virtual sessions (including those requested by leadership) will be a key activity for this role. Additionally, this role will involve managing our content management approach and maintaining key tools, such as SharePoint and MS Teams, to ensure compliance with Information Security requirements.
Qualifications
Essential Responsibilities
On/Off Boarding Process

  • Become key point of contact for the network to be aware of all new joiners, leavers and internal rotations.
  • Create, maintain and share onboarding materials, welcome emails and lead induction calls with new joiners ensuring these are included in our distro lists and granted access to key tools as needed.
  • Take required actions for leavers (remove access, etc.).
  • Maintenance of who is who pack and internal contact site and others e.g. Resources File, CC Facebook
Network Engagement And Communications
  • Support the coordination and delivery of key engagement sessions with logistics, recording, interaction tools (i.e. Menti), and co-presenting.
  • Support launch of a regular newsletter for the team (including information about different programs, stories, milestones and updates).
  • Monitor and follow up questions and connections happening during engagement sessions.
  • Attendance tracking.
  • Creation and Maintenance of key power point/trackers (i.e. virtual sessions presentations, Case studies; Story Tracker, etc.).
  • Provide ad-hoc support to our network.
Content Management & SharePoint and MS Teams (tool and content) Maintenance:
  • Responsible for the SharePoint structure, content and access maintenance.
  • Maintenance of MS Teams channels and information stored there.
  • Be up to date on Accenture´s content management approach and share tips and resources with the network and global team.
  • Define Content Management Approach for our global team and promote to ensure all team is following same criteria to store/maintain content
  • Collaboration with Corporate Citizenship Information Security Lead to ensure compliance of requirements and alignment with Corporate Citizenship retention schedule.
Global Subscriptions, Survey Management And CC Mailbox Follow Up
  • Key Point of Contact to manage the relationship and processes related to the different Global CC Subscriptions (promotion, budget notification, usage assessment, leading the approval process for renewal or cancellation, etc.).
  • Creation, launch and maintenance of Surveys in ConfirmIt/Forsta.
  • Pro Bono Surveys Process: Quarterly reporting and Guidance Maintenance
  • Monitor and follow up questions/emails received through the Corporate Citizenship Mailbox and the Accenture Direct inquires .and PoC for Accenture Direct questions to ensure emails are re-direct to key SME/Contacts.
Other Ad-hoc Support
  • Leadership Requests.
  • Connecting with team members to get stories from the different teams and geographies - regarding different topics (E.g.: Disaster Relief, PwD, Environmental sustainability, Pride, among many others) to publish them later.
Required Skills And Experience
  • Collaborative and team player.
  • Organized and able to work in a virtual international environment.
  • Strong networking skills.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills in English.
  • Self-motivated and reliable.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Expert level of Power point and SharePoint.
  • Experience with collaboration tools, e.g. MS Teams, SharePoint.
Nice To Have Experience
  • Knowledge and genuine interest of Accenture's Corporate Citizenship programs and more broadly about Corporate Social Responsibility and social impact matters.

Essa posição reportará ao Head de Operações, assumindo frentes operacionais, administrativas e de suporte comercial quando necessário.

É fundamental ter excelente capacidade analítica, organização, boa comunicação e um olhar proativo para identificar oportunidades na base de clientes. Terá papel essencial na gestão e acompanhamento dos colaboradores, identificação de oportunidades e interface com recrutamento e Business Partners.

  • Apoiar ações de engajamento com clientes e colaboradores.
  • Garantir organização e execução de processos rotineiros, com controle de prazos e registros.

O Que Estamos Buscando

  • Capacidade de análise, organização e autonomia para gerenciar múltiplos processos e conflitos.

  • Perfil proativo, com visão de negócio e foco em resultados.
  • Inglês intermediário a avançado.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar presencialmente em Porto Alegre e viagens pontuais.

Será Um Diferencial Se Você

  • Experiência com engajamento de colaboradores alocados em clientes.
  • Foco comercial, atento a oportunidades de crescimento e upsell.

Onde Você Vai Trabalhar

Modalidade de Contratação

O Que Oferecemos

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição, Plano de Saúde Unimed, Plano Odontológico, TotalPass, Zenklub, Programa de Indicação, Seguro de Vida, Auxílio Creche, Baby Zallpy, Comunidades Voluntárias, Descontos em Instituições de Ensino, experiências e desenvolvimento, suporte de BP.

Seja na sua vida pessoal ou profissional, a Zallpy se preocupa com seu crescimento e bem-estar. Venha fazer parte dessa jornada conosco!

Sobre a Empresa

title: Freelance Credit Research Analyst - Latin America
description:
The Role:

We're looking for an experienced credit research analyst to join our Debtwire Credit Research Team. The team provides unique insights and valuation analysis on companies and their securities that are restructuring, in the process of a transforming event or raising capital. Key tasks will include reviewing financial statements and legal documents to produce detailed credit research on stressed, distressed, and restructuring companies. The analysis will be produced in reports produced for subscribers of Debtwire, an ION Analytics subsidiary.

You will have the option to work remotely, including a flexible contract and competitive rates.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Produce Credit Reports that provide financial and valuation analysis on high-yield, distressed and stressed companies.
  • Interact with subscribers electronically and personally to discuss credit and macro analysis.
  • Along with creating credit research, the candidate will assist in special reports and ad-hoc projects.
  • Interact with management and IR teams of companies covered. Attend conferences and company investor day as needed.
Required Skills, Experience, and Qualifications
  • The candidate should have 5+ years as either a credit or equity analyst.
  • Naturally curious and driven to figure out how to analyze complex situations and be tenacious in obtaining information.
  • Excellent understanding of financial statements: income statement, balance sheet and cash flows and the drive to thoroughly read the information supporting the financial statements.
  • A thorough understanding of debt and equity securities and the markets they trade in is required, including some knowledge of bankruptcy processes.
  • Valuation experience including waterfall, and DCF analysis is required.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of fixed income analytics (ie Z-spread, duration).
  • Fluency in Portuguese and/or Spanish (both strongly preferred).
  • Comprehensive knowledge of Excel and Word
  • Excellent writing skills, with the ability to build a thesis and reach a conclusion in a structured manner, are required.
  • Experience writing reports in English.
  • Ability to work in a team-based environment, with a sense of teamwork and cooperation
  • Ability to manage workflow under strict deadlines

About us

We’re a diverse group of visionary innovators who provide trading and workflow automation software, high-value analytics, and strategic consulting to corporations, central banks, financial institutions, and governments. Founded in 1999, we’ve achieved tremendous growth by bringing together some of the best and most successful financial technology companies in the world.

• Over 2,000 of the world’s leading corporations, including 50% of the Fortune 500 and 30% of the world’s central banks, trust ION solutions to manage their cash, in-house banking, commodity supply chain, trading and risk.

• Over 800 of the world’s leading banks and broker-dealers use our electronic trading platforms to operate the world’s financial market infrastructure.

ION is a rapidly expanding and dynamic group with 13,000 employees and offices in more than 40 cities around the globe. Our ever-expanding global footprint, cutting edge products, and over 40,000 customers worldwide provide an unparalleled career experience for those who share our vision.

ION is committed to maintaining a supportive and inclusive environment for people with diverse backgrounds and experiences. title: ANALISTA DE LOGÍSTICA III
description:
Join to apply for the ANALISTA DE LOGÍSTICA III role at Kraft Heinz

Vaga direcionada para mulheres/Pessoas negras/Pcds.

Job Description

O Analista de Logística III é responsável por analisar o fluxo de recebimento e expedição de produtos acabados, bem como devoluções. Analisar estoques cíclicos e inventário geral com auditoria externa. Além disso, precisa garantir a política de estoque, realizar a gestão de desempenho de indicadores, construção de dashboards e governança de dados, com foco em diagnóstico e ganhos de produtividade.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Recebimento e Expedição: Analisar as movimentações contábeis de estoque e armazenagem para identificar e mitigar possíveis erros operacionais;
  • Controle de Estoque de Produtos Acabados: Controlar o estoque por meio de inventário cíclico trimestral e inventário geral anual, baixas por danos industriais, prazo de validade, devoluções/devoluções e danos internos;
  • Fóruns com áreas parceiras: Realizar fóruns com áreas parceiras, diários e semanais, para identificar pontos de melhoria e colaboração;
  • Análise de banco de dados e elaboração de indicadores: Utilizar o conhecimento em análise de dados para contribuir para a construção de indicadores de desempenho e ganhos de produtividade;
  • Segurança e Qualidade: Realizar rotinas diárias e semanais de segurança e qualidade utilizando ferramentas específicas, além de analisar inventário de não conformidades com a equipe de qualidade.

REQUISITOS

  • Graduação completa em Administração, Logística ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em operações de armazenagem;
  • Experiência com Inbound/Outbound;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel e SAP;
  • Desejável conhecimento em Power BI;
  • Conhecimento em Banco de Dados (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, etc.);
  • Inglês será considerado um diferencial.

Localização: Nerópolis CD, Brasil

Kraft Heinz é um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais – Grupos Minoritários Subrepresentados, Mulheres, Veteranos, Pessoas com Deficiências, Orientação Sexual, Identidade de Gênero e outras classes protegidas.
